actions.desc: mw 4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}7 (1d10 + 2) piercing damage, and the target must make a DC 11 Constitution saving throw, taking 18 (4d8) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If the poison damage reduces the target to 0 hit points, the target is stable but poisoned for 1 hour, even after regaining hit points, and is paralyzed while poisoned in this way.

traits.name: Ambusher
traits.desc: The sand spider has advantage on attack rolls against any creature it has surprised.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.desc: The spider can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings upside down, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Ambush Burrow
traits.desc: When a creature passes over a sand spider's hidden burrow, the spider can use its reaction to attack that creature with two impaling leg attacks; the creature is considered surprised for both attacks. If either or both attacks hit and the target is a Medium or smaller creature, the spider and the target contest Strength. If the target wins, it can immediately move 5 feet away from the spider. On a tie, it is grappled (escape DC 15). If the spider wins, it grapples the target and drags it 30 feet into its lair. If the creature is still grappled at the start of the spider's next turn, it is instead restrained. Once restrained, it can escape by using an action and succeeding on a DC 15 Strength (Athletics) check.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The sand spider makes two impaling leg attacks and one bite attack.

actions.name: Impaling Legs
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (1d12+5) piercing damage. If the sand spider scores a critical hit with this attack, roll the damage dice three times instead of twice. If both impaling leg attacks hit the same target, the second hit deals an extra 11 (1d12+5) piercing damage.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 16 (2d10+5) piercing damage plus 13 (3d8) poison damage, or half as much poison damage on a successful DC 13 Constitution saving throw.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.desc: The spider can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Web Sense
traits.desc: While in contact with a web, the spider knows the exact location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

traits.name: Web Walker
traits.desc: The spider ignores movement restrictions caused by webbing.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage, and the target must make a DC 11 Constitution saving throw, taking 9 (2d8) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If the poison damage reduces the target to 0 hit points, the target is stable but poisoned for 1 hour, even after regaining hit points, and is paralyzed while poisoned in this way.

actions.name: Web {@recharge 5}
actions.desc: rw 5 to hit, range 30/60 ft., one creature. {@h}The target is restrained by webbing. As an action, the restrained target can make a DC 12 Strength check, bursting the webbing on a success. The webbing can also be attacked and destroyed (AC 10; hp 5; vulnerability to fire damage; immunity to bludgeoning, poison, and psychic damage).

traits.name: Camouflaged Webs
traits.desc: A DC 15 Wisdom (Perception) check is required to spot a j'ba fofi's web. A creature that doesn't notice it and comes into contact with the web is restrained. A restrained creature can free itself by using an action and succeeding on a DC 12 Strength check. The web can be attacked and destroyed (AC 10, 5 hp, vulnerability to fire damage, immunity to bludgeoning, poison, and psychic damage).

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.desc: The spider can climb any surface, including walking on ceilings, without making an ability check.

traits.name: Arachnid Sympathy
traits.desc: No ordinary spider attacks a j'ba fofi unless magically controlled or attacked first. In addition, every j'ba fofi is accompanied by a swarm of spiders (a variant of the insect swarm) that moves and attacks at the j'ba fofi's mental direction (directing the swarm costs it no action).

traits.name: Web Sense
traits.desc: While in contact with a web, the j'ba fofi knows the exact location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

traits.name: Web Walker
traits.desc: The spider ignores movement restrictions caused by webs.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 8 (1d10+3) piercing damage plus 22 (5d8) poison damage, or half as much poison damage on a successful DC 12 Constitution saving throw. A target reduced to 0 hit points by this attack is stable but poisoned and paralyzed for 1 hour, even after regaining hit points.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.desc: The spider can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Web Sense
traits.desc: While in contact with a web, the spider knows the exact location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

traits.name: Web Walker
traits.desc: The spider ignores movement restrictions caused by webbing.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: mw 3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}4 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage, and the target must make a DC 11 Constitution saving throw, taking 7 (2d6) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If the poison damage reduces the target to 0 hit points, the target is stable but poisoned for 1 hour, even after regaining hit points, and is paralyzed while poisoned in this way.

traits.name: Specter Walk
traits.desc: As a bonus action, the specter spider turns invisible and intangible. This invisibility doesn't end when it attacks. While invisible, the spider has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks and gains the following benefits: resistance to acid, cold, fire, lightning, and thunder damage; resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical weapons; immunity to the paralyzed, petrified, prone, restrained, and stunned conditions. The specter walk ends when the spider ends it as a bonus action or when it dies.

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement (Specter Walk Only)
traits.desc: The specter spider can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.desc: The spider can climb any surface, including walking on ceilings, without making an ability check.

traits.name: Web Walker
traits.desc: The spider ignores movement restrictions caused by webs.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The specter spider makes two bite attacks. It can make one phantom snare attack in place of a bite attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d10+5) piercing damage plus 13 (3d8) poison damage, or half as much poison damage on a successful DC 15 Constitution saving throw. If the poison damage reduces the target to 0 hit points, it is stable but poisoned and paralyzed for 1 hour, even after regaining hit points. While the spider is using its specter walk, its bite and poison deal half damage to targets not affected by a phantom snare (see below).

actions.name: Phantom Snare (Specter Walk Only, Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, range 40/160 ft., one target. Hit: the target is restrained by a ghostly web. While restrained this way, it is invisible to all creatures except specter spiders and has resistance to acid, cold, fire, lightning, and thunder damage. A creature restrained by a phantom snare can escape by spending an action and succeeding on a DC 14 Strength check. The web strands can also be attacked and destroyed (AC 10, 5 hp).

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.desc: The thief spider is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The thief spider has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Assisted Leap
traits.desc: If its barbed line attack is available, the spider can use its movement to leap 20 feet in a direction of its choice, trailing the line like a strand of web. The line anchors to an object, and the spider reels itself in immediately. It can carry up to 25 extra pounds when moving this way. This kind of movement doesn't count as spending the barbed line attack.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The thief spider makes two sickle-claw attacks.

actions.name: Sickle Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d8+1) slashing damage.

actions.name: Barbed Line (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d4+1) piercing damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 10). Instead of moving, the thief spider can retract the barbed line and pull itself onto the grappled creature (it enters and stays in that creature's space). The spider's sickle claw attack has advantage against a grappled creature in the same space. If the grappled creature breaks free, the spider immediately moves into an occupied space within 5 feet.

arbeyach.name: Arbeyach
arbeyach.speed: 40 ft., burrow 20 ft., climb 40 ft., fly 80 ft. (hover)

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If Arbeyach fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: Arbeyach has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.desc: Arbeyach's weapon attacks are magical.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc: Arbeyach's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 22, +14 to hit with spell attacks). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components. At will: poison spray. 3/day each: fog cloud, stinking cloud. 1/day each: contagion, insect plague, cloudkill

traits.name: Aura of Fear
traits.desc: Any creature hostile to Arbeyach that starts its turn within 20 feet of it must succeed on a DC 22 Wisdom saving throw unless Arbeyach is incapacitated. On a failure, the creature is frightened until the start of its next turn. On a success, the creature is immune to Arbeyach's aura of fear for the next 24 hours.

traits.name: Aura of Virulence
traits.desc: Creatures that would normally be resistant or immune to poison damage or the poisoned condition lose that resistance or immunity while within 120 feet of Arbeyach. All other creatures in that area have disadvantage on saving throws against effects that deal poison damage or impose the poisoned condition.

traits.name: Prince of Swarms
traits.desc: Within 120 feet, Arbeyach can communicate via pheromone transmission with Arbeyach's spawn and with all insects and vermin, including swarms and giant varieties. Within a hive, this range extends to the entire hive. This is a silent, instantaneous mode of communication that only Arbeyach, its spawn, insects, and vermin can understand. All such creatures obey Arbeyach and never harm it.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Arbeyach makes one bite attack and two claw attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) poison damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 22 Constitution saving throw or be afflicted with a curse called Arbeyach's rot. The cursed target is poisoned, can't regain hit points, has its hit point maximum reduced by 13 (3d8) every 24 hours, and is attacked on sight by vermin. If the target's hit point maximum drops to 0 as a result of the curse, it dies and immediately transforms into a swarm of randomly chosen insects. The curse lasts until it is removed with remove curse or similar magic.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d8 + 6) slashing damage plus 9 (2d8) poison damage.

actions.name: Vermin Breath (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: Arbeyach exhales a cloud of vermin in a line 120 feet long and 10 feet wide. Each creature in that line takes 54 (12d8) poison damage, or half as much damage on a successful DC 22 Dexterity saving throw. A creature that fails the saving throw must also make a DC 22 Constitution saving throw to avoid being afflicted with Arbeyach's rot (see the Bite attack). In addition, Arbeyach summons a swarm of insects (of any kind) at a point of its choice on the line. The swarm persists for 2 minutes unless it is destroyed or Arbeyach dismisses it as a bonus action. Arbeyach can have no more than five insect swarms at a time.

legendaryActions.name: Move
legendaryActions.desc: Arbeyach moves up to half its speed, using whichever movement type it chooses.

legendaryActions.name: Poison
legendaryActions.desc: Arbeyach targets one creature within 120 feet of it. If the target isn't poisoned, it must succeed on a DC 22 Constitution saving throw or become poisoned. A poisoned target repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

legendaryActions.name: Cast a Spell (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.desc: Arbeyach casts a spell.

arbre-eveille.name: Awakened Tree
languages: one language known by its creator

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.desc: While the tree remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal tree.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: mw 6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}14 (3d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

arbre-feuilledragon.name: Dragonleaf Tree
arbre-feuilledragon.languages: understands the languages of its creator or its designated master

traits.name: Loyal to Dragon Master
traits.desc: A dragonleaf tree follows only the orders of its designated master (or of any creature to which that master has handed over control). It has advantage on saving throws against spells or effects that would charm or compel it. In addition, the tree has advantage on all saving throws made to resist a Bluff, Diplomacy, or Intimidation check intended to influence it to act against its master.

traits.name: Weaknesses
traits.desc: Dragonleaf trees immune to fire are vulnerable to cold, and trees immune to cold are vulnerable to fire.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 58 (10d10 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Leaves
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, range 30/60 ft., one target. Hit: 45 (10d8) slashing damage.

actions.name: Breath (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: A dragonleaf tree can use its leaves to create a breath weapon matching the dragon it honors. The creature's breath deals 49 (14d6) damage, or half as much damage to targets that succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw. A black, copper, or green tree spits a 60-foot line of acid; a blue or bronze tree spits a 60-foot line of lightning; a brass, gold, or red tree spits a 30-foot cone of fire; and a silver or white tree spits a 30-foot cone of cold.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: A feywarden tree has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Contractibility and Conductivity
traits.desc: Certain spells and effects affect feywarden trees in special ways. A magical attack that deals cold damage slows a feywarden tree (as if it were under the effects of the slow spell) for 3 rounds. A magical attack that deals lightning damage ends any slow effect on the feywarden tree and lets it regain 1 hit point for every 3 points of damage the attack would otherwise deal. If this healing raises the tree's hit points above its hit point maximum, the excess becomes temporary hit points. The tree makes no saving throws against lightning effects.

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.desc: A feywarden tree is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.desc: A feywarden tree's weapon attacks are magical.

traits.name: Guardian Reach
traits.desc: Creatures within 15 feet of a feywarden tree provoke opportunity attacks from it even if they take the Disengage action before moving out of reach.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The tree makes two razor-leaf branch attacks and, as a bonus action, it can make one razor-leaf branch attack against a creature adjacent to its space.

actions.name: Razor-Leaf Branch
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (3d8 + 8) slashing damage.

actions.name: Flaying Leaves (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: The tree can hurl a volley of razor-sharp cold iron leaves in a 20-foot radius around it. All creatures in the area of effect must make a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw. A creature takes 21 (6d6) slashing damage on a failure, or half as much on a success.

arbuste-eveille.name: Awakened Shrub
languages: one language known by its creator

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.desc: While the shrub remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal shrub.

actions.name: Rake
actions.desc: mw 1 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}1 (1d4 - 1) slashing damage.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The arcanaloth has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.desc: The arcanaloth's weapon attacks are magical.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: mw 7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 (2d4 + 3) slashing damage. The target must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw, taking 10 (3d6) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

actions.name: Teleport
actions.desc: The arcanaloth magically teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

traits.name: Beast Hunter
traits.desc: The elven veteran archer has advantage on Wisdom (Survival) checks to track a beast and on Intelligence (Nature) checks to recall information about a beast.

traits.name: Fey Ancestry
traits.desc: The veteran archer has advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put it to sleep.

traits.name: Keen Sight and Hearing
traits.desc: The veteran archer has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.desc: The veteran archer's weapon attacks are magical.

traits.name: Quiet Traveler
traits.desc: The elven veteran archer can use Stealth even while moving at a normal pace.

traits.name: Surprise Attack
traits.desc: If the veteran archer surprises a creature and hits it with an attack during the first round of combat, the target takes an extra 7 (2d6) damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The elven veteran archer makes two melee attacks or three ranged attacks.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Longbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Volley (Recharge 6)
actions.desc: The veteran archer makes a ranged attack against every enemy within 10 feet of a point it can see.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: Doc Watson has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Portent {@recharge}
traits.desc: When Doc Watson or a creature he can see makes an attack roll, a saving throw, or an ability check, Doc Watson can roll a d20 and choose to use this roll in place of the attack roll, saving throw, or ability check. This trait recharges after using the Spellcasting action.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Doc Watson makes three Arcane Burst attacks.

actions.name: Arcane Burst
actions.desc: ms,rs 9 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft., one target. {@h}32 (5d10 + 5) lightning damage.

traits.name: Card Sense
traits.desc: The riffler can smell the presence of magical cards, including Decks of Many Things and other magical decks, within 1 mile of itself. It knows the direction to any such cards in that range. Effects that protect a target from divination magic block this sense.

traits.name: Riffling Step
traits.desc: The riffler can burrow through any nonmagical material that isn't iron, shuffling the substance through which the riffler moves aside like cards to form a tunnel that closes behind the riffler.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The riffler makes two Spectral Card attacks.

actions.name: Spectral Card
actions.desc: ms,rs 6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one target. {@h}8 (1d10 + 3) force damage plus 5 (1d10) damage that is radiant if the d10 roll is an even number and necrotic if it's odd.

actions.name: Card Spray {@recharge 5}
actions.desc: The riffler magically unleashes a spray of spectral cards in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 27 (5d10) force damage and has the restrained condition for 1 minute as cards bind it. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage only. A restrained creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.name: Plane Shift
actions.desc: The riffler casts the Plane Shift spell targeting only itself, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability.

reactions.name: Shuffle Destiny
reactions.desc: When a creature the riffler can see within 30 feet of itself makes an ability check, an attack roll, or a saving throw, the riffler can magically force that creature to roll a d6 and either add the number rolled to the total or subtract it from the total (riffler's choice), potentially changing the outcome.

traits.name: Antimagic Susceptibility
traits.desc: The armor is incapacitated while in the area of an antimagic field. If targeted by dispel magic, the armor must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against the caster's spell save DC or fall unconscious for 1 minute.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.desc: While the armor remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal suit of armor.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The armor makes two melee attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: mw 4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

traits.name: Special Equipment
traits.desc:
Artus wears the Ring of Winter. He and the ring can't be targeted by divination magic or perceived through magical scrying sensors. While attuned to and wearing the ring, Artus ceases to age and is immune to cold damage and the effects of extreme cold.

Artus wields Bookmark a +3 dagger with additional magical properties. As a bonus action, Artus can activate any one of the following properties while attuned to the dagger, provided he has the weapon drawn:

- Cause a blue gem set into the dagger's pommel to shed bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light for an additional 20 feet, or make the gem go dark.
- Turn the dagger into a compass that, while resting on your palm, points north.
- Cast dimension door from the dagger. Once this property is used, it can't be used again until the next dawn.
- Cast compulsion (save DC 15) from the dagger. The range of the spell increases to 90 feet but it targets only spiders that are beasts. Once this property is used, it can't be used again until the next dawn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Artus makes three attacks with Bookmark or his longbow.

actions.name: Bookmark (+3 Dagger)
actions.desc: mw 8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 (1d4 + 5) piercing damage.

actions.name: Longbow
actions.desc: rw 5 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target {@h}6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Ring of Winter
actions.desc:
The Ring of Winter has 12 charges and regains all its expended charges daily at dawn. While attuned to and wearing the ring, Artus can expend the necessary number of charges to activate one of the following properties:

- Artus can expend 1 charge and use the ring to lower the temperature in a 120-foot-radius sphere centered on a point he can see within 300 feet of him. The temperature in that area drops 20 degrees per minute, to a minimum of −30 degrees Fahrenheit. Frost and ice begin to form on surfaces once the temperature drops below 32 degrees. This effect is permanent unless Artus uses the ring to end the effect as an action, at which point the temperature in the area returns to normal at a rate of 10 degrees per minute.
- Artus can cast one of the following spells from the ring (spell save DC 17) by expending the necessary number of charges: Bigby's hand (2 charges) the hand is made of ice, is immune to cold damage, and deals bludgeoning damage instead of force damage as a clenched fist, cone of cold (2 charges), flesh to stone (3 charges); as flesh to stone except that the target turns to solid ice with the density and durability of stone, ice storm (2 charges), Otiluke's freezing sphere (3 charges), sleet storm (1 charge), spike growth (1 charge) the spikes are made of ice, or wall of ice (2 charges).
- Artus can expend the necessary number of charges and use the ring to create either an inanimate ice object (2 charges) or an animated ice creature (4 charges). The ice object can't have any moving parts, must be able to fit inside a 10-foot cube, and has the density and durability of metal or stone (Artus's choice). The ice creature must be modeled after a beast with a challenge rating of 2 or less. The ice creature has the same statistics as the beast it models, with the following changes: the creature is a construct with vulnerability to fire damage, immunity to cold and poison damage, and immunity to the following conditions: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, and poisoned. The ice creature obeys only its creator's commands. The object or creature appears in an unoccupied space within 60 feet of Artus. It melts into a pool of normal water after 24 hours or when it drops to 0 hit points. In extreme heat, it loses 5 (1d10) hit points per minute as it melts. Use the guidelines in chapter 8 of the Dungeon Master's Guide to determine the hit points of an inanimate object if they become necessary.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.desc: An asanbosam can climb difficult surfaces, including moving upside down along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Tree Dweller
traits.desc: While in a tree, an asanbosam can take the Disengage or Hide action as a bonus action on each of its turns.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: An asanbosam makes one bite attack and one claw attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution check against disease. On a failure, it takes 11 (2d10) poison damage and is poisoned until the disease is cured. Every 24 hours, the victim must repeat the saving throw. On a failure, its hit point maximum is reduced by 5 (1d10). This reduction persists until the disease is cured. If the creature's hit point maximum drops to 0 as a result of the disease, it dies.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (3d10 + 4) piercing damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 14). While grappled this way, the target is restrained, and the asanbosam can't claw another target. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw against disease or contract the disease described in the Bite attack section.

assassin.name: Assassin
languages: Thieves' cant plus any two languages

traits.name: Assassinate
traits.desc: During its first turn, the assassin has advantage on attack rolls against any creature that hasn't taken a turn. Any hit the assassin scores against a surprised creature is a critical hit.

traits.name: Evasion
traits.desc: If the assassin is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, the assassin instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if it fails.

traits.name: Sneak Attack (1/Turn)
traits.desc: The assassin deals an extra 14 (4d6) damage when it hits a target with a weapon attack and has advantage on the attack roll, or when the target is within 5 feet of an ally of the assassin that isn't incapacitated and the assassin doesn't have disadvantage on the attack roll.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The assassin makes two shortsword attacks.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.desc: mw 6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage, and the target must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw, taking 24 (7d6) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

actions.name: Light Crossbow
actions.desc: rw 6 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. {@h}7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage, and the target must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw, taking 24 (7d6) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

assoiffeur-gris.name: Vampirate
languages: the languages it knew in life

traits.name: Explode
traits.desc: When the vampirate is reduced to 0 hit points, it explodes in a cloud of ash. Any creature within 5 feet of it must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or take 5 (1d10) necrotic damage.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.desc: The vampirate can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Unusual Nature
traits.desc: The vampirate doesn't require air or drink.

actions.name: Energy Drain
actions.desc: ms,rs 4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30 ft., one creature. {@h}11 (2d10) necrotic damage. A Humanoid reduced to 0 hit points by this attack dies and instantly transforms into a free-willed shadow under the DM's control.

actions.name: Light Crossbow
actions.desc: rw 4 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. {@h}11 (2d8 + 2) piercing damage.

atropal.name: Atropal
languages: understands Celestial but utters only obscene nonsense

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The atropal has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Negative Energy Aura
traits.desc: Creatures within 30 feet of the atropal can't regain hit points, and any creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of the atropal takes 10 (3d6) necrotic damage. If the atropal is struck by a vorpal sword, the wielder can cut the atropal's umbilical cord instead of dealing damage. If its umbilical cord is cut, the atropal loses this feature.

traits.name: Turn Resistance Aura
traits.desc: The atropal and any other undead creature within 30 feet of it has advantage on saving throws against any effect that turns undead.

actions.name: Touch
actions.desc: mw 9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 (3d6) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Ray of Cold
actions.desc: rs 12 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. {@h}21 (6d6) cold damage.

actions.name: Life Drain
actions.desc: The atropal targets one creature it can see within 120 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 19 Constitution saving throw, taking 36 (8d8) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The atropal regains a number of hit points equal to half the amount of damage dealt.

actions.name: Summon Wraith {@recharge}
actions.desc: The atropal summons a wraith which materializes within 30 feet of it in an unoccupied space it can see. The wraith obeys its summoner's commands and can't be controlled by any other creature. The Wraith vanishes when it drops to 0 hit points or when its summoner dies.

legendaryActions.name: Touch
legendaryActions.desc: The atropal makes a touch attack.

legendaryActions.name: Ray of Cold (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.desc: The atropal uses its Ray of Cold.

legendaryActions.name: Wail (Costs 3 Actions)
legendaryActions.desc: The atropal lets out a withering wail. Any creature within 120 feet of the atropal that can hear the wail must succeed on a DC 19 Constitution saving throw or gain 1 level of exhaustion.

traits.name: Attractive Pollen (1/Day)
traits.desc: When the mantrap detects any creatures nearby, it can use its reaction to release pollen out to a radius of 30 feet. Any beast or humanoid within the area must succeed on a DC 11 Wisdom saving throw or be forced to use all its movement on its turns to get as close to the the mantrap as possible. An affected target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.desc: While the mantrap remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary tropical plant.

actions.name: Engulf
actions.desc: mw 4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one Medium or smaller creature. {@h}The target is trapped inside the mantrap's leafy jaws. While trapped in this way, the target is blinded and restrained, has Cover from an attacks and other effects outside the mantrap, and takes 14 (4d6) acid damage at the start of each of the target's turns. If the mantrap dies, the creature inside it is no longer restrained by it. A mantrap can engulf only one creature at a time.

traits.name: Extradimensional Book Repository
traits.desc: A small door on the librarian automaton's chest opens onto an extradimensional shelf. It functions exactly like a bag of holding, but it can hold only written material, such as books, scrolls, folders, notebooks, spellbooks, and the like.

actions.name: Confounding Gaze
actions.desc: The librarian automaton chooses one creature it can see within 40 feet. The target must succeed on a DC 12 Intelligence saving throw or take 9 (3d4 + 2) psychic damage and have disadvantage on Intelligence-based checks, saving throws, and attacks until the end of its next turn. On a successful save, the creature takes half damage and suffers no other effect.

actions.name: Bibliotelekinesis
actions.desc: This power functions like the mage hand cantrip, but it works only on books, scrolls, maps, and other printed or written materials.

traits.name: Standing Leap
traits.desc: The ostrich can jump up to 20 feet long and up to 10 feet high, with or without a running start.

traits.name: Bounding Warrior
traits.desc: If a riderless ostrich jumps at least 10 feet and lands within 5 feet of a creature, it has advantage on attacks against that creature.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The ostrich makes two claw attacks.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

traits.name: Freezing Presence
traits.desc: Boreas freezes everything within 150 feet of him. After 5 rounds, nonmagical fires the size of a campfire are extinguished. Water freezes after 1 minute. Spells that protect against cold are immediately subject to dispel magic (with a spellcasting ability of +10) within 150 feet of Boreas.

traits.name: Wind Form
traits.desc: As an action, Boreas can shift between his humanoid body and a body made of wind and mist, but he can't be forced to change shape. In his wind form, he can use his whirling burst attack and cast his spells, but he can't make weapon attacks. A creature with truesight sees both his forms at once.

traits.name: Freedom of the Wind
traits.desc: No lock, manacle, rope, or other bond can hold Boreas.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc: Boreas's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 19). He can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components. At will: aid, speak with animals, create or destroy water, detect magic, invisibility, polymorph, wind wall, true seeing. 3/day each: call lightning, control weather, dispel magic, lesser restoration, cure wounds, ice storm. 1/day each: chain lightning, shapechange, finger of death, heal, word of recall, wall of ice, earthquake

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.desc: The avatar of Boreas regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn. If the avatar of Boreas takes fire damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of its next turn. The avatar of Boreas dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Boreas makes four ice lance attacks, four north wind longbow attacks, or two whirling bursts.

actions.name: Ice Lance (Humanoid Form Only)
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (1d8 + 7) piercing damage plus 17 (5d6) cold damage.

actions.name: North Wind Longbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d8 + 6) piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) cold damage.

actions.name: Whirling Burst (Wind Form Only)
actions.desc: Ranged Spell Attack: +11 to hit, range 50 ft., one target. Hit: 37 (5d12 + 5) slashing damage.

legendaryActions.name: Ice Lance
legendaryActions.desc: Boreas makes one ice lance attack.

legendaryActions.name: Icy Gaze of the North Wind
legendaryActions.desc: Boreas can freeze an enemy with a glance. A creature within 60 feet of the avatar of Boreas that it can see must succeed on a DC 19 Constitution saving throw or be petrified until the start of the avatar's next turn.

legendaryActions.name: Whirlwind Movement (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.desc: Boreas suddenly transforms into an icy whirlwind. Normal and magical light sources within 20 feet of him are automatically extinguished. Each creature within 20 feet of the avatar must succeed on a DC 21 Dexterity saving throw or take 14 (4d6) cold damage. The avatar can then fly away, moving up to half its flying speed.

avatar-de-la-mort.name: Avatar of Death
languages: all languages known to its summoner

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.desc: The avatar can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

traits.name: Turn Immunity
traits.desc: The avatar is immune to features that turn undead.

actions.name: Reaping Scythe
actions.desc: The avatar sweeps its spectral scythe through a creature within 5 feet of it, dealing 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage plus 4 (1d8) necrotic damage.

traits.name: Heated Body
traits.desc: A creature that touches the azer or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 5 (1d10) fire damage.

traits.name: Heated Weapons
traits.desc: When the azer hits with a metal melee weapon, it deals an extra 3 (1d6) fire damage (included in the attack).

traits.name: Illumination
traits.desc: The azer sheds bright light in a 10-foot radius and dim light for an additional 10 feet.

actions.name: Warhammer
actions.desc: mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage, or 8 (1d10 + 3) bludgeoning damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack, plus 3 (1d6) fire damage.

traits.name: Aberrant Ground
traits.desc: The ground in a 10-foot radius around the mouther is doughlike difficult terrain. Each creature that starts its turn in that area must succeed on a DC 10 Strength saving throw or have its speed reduced to 0 until the start of its next turn.

traits.name: Gibbering
traits.desc: The mouther babbles incoherently while it can see any creature and isn't incapacitated. Each creature that starts its turn within 20 feet of the mouther and can hear the gibbering must succeed on a DC 10 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, the creature can't take reactions until the start of its next turn and rolls a d8 to determine what it does during its turn. On a 1 to 4, the creature does nothing. On a 5 or 6, the creature takes no action or bonus action and uses all its movement to move in a randomly determined direction. On a 7 or 8, the creature makes a melee attack against a randomly determined creature within its reach or does nothing if it can't make such an attack.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The gibbering mouther makes one bite attack and, if it can, uses its Blinding Spittle.

actions.name: Bites
actions.desc: mw 2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}17 (5d6) piercing damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, it must succeed on a DC 10 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is killed by this damage, it is absorbed into the mouther.

actions.name: Blinding Spittle {@recharge 5}
actions.desc: The mouther spits a chemical glob at a point it can see within 15 feet of it. The glob explodes in a blinding flash of light on impact. Each creature within 5 feet of the flash must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or be blinded until the end of the mouther's next turn.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.desc: The baboon has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the baboon's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: mw 1 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}1 (1d4 - 1) piercing damage.

traits.name: Healing Oil
traits.desc: As an action, a bagiennik can automatically stabilize a dying creature by smearing some of its oily secretion on the creature's flesh. If it performs the same gesture on a creature that is already stable or that has at least 1 hit point, the oil has the same effect as a potion of healing and restores 2d4 + 2 hit points to the creature. Alternatively, the bagiennik's secretion can have the same effect as the lesser restoration spell. However, any creature that receives a bagiennik's healing oil must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be slowed for 1 minute.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: A bagiennik makes two claw attacks.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (4d6 + 4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Acid Jet
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, range 15 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d10 + 3) acid damage. The target must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw to avoid falling prone because of the slippery oil, which covers a 5-foot-square area. A creature that enters the oily area or ends its turn there must also make a Dexterity saving throw to avoid falling. A creature makes only one saving throw per turn per 5-foot-square area, even if it enters and ends its turn in the same area. The slippery effect lasts for 3 rounds.

traits.name: Death Throes
traits.desc: When the balor dies, it explodes, and each creature within 30 feet of it must make a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw, taking 70 (20d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The explosion ignites flammable objects in that area that aren't being worn or carried, and it destroys the balor's weapons.

traits.name: Fire Aura
traits.desc: At the start of each of the balor's turns, each creature within 5 feet of it takes 10 (3d6) fire damage, and flammable objects in the aura that aren't being worn or carried ignite. A creature that touches the balor or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 10 (3d6) fire damage.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The balor has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.desc: The balor's weapon attacks are magical.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The balor makes two attacks: one with its longsword and one with its whip.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.desc: mw 14 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}21 (3d8 + 8) slashing damage plus 13 (3d8) lightning damage. If the balor scores a critical hit, it rolls damage dice three times, instead of twice.

actions.name: Whip
actions.desc: mw 14 to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. {@h}15 (2d6 + 8) slashing damage plus 10 (3d6) fire damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 20 Strength saving throw or be pulled up to 25 feet toward the balor.

actions.name: Teleport
actions.desc: The balor magically teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

actions.name: Scimitar
actions.desc: mw 3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 (1d6 + 1) slashing damage.

actions.name: Light Crossbow
actions.desc: rw 3 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. {@h}5 (1d8 + 1) piercing damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The captain makes three melee attacks: two with its scimitar and one with its dagger. Or the captain makes two ranged attacks with its daggers.

actions.name: Scimitar
actions.desc: mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.desc: mw,rw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage.

reactions.name: Parry
reactions.desc: The captain adds 2 to its AC against one melee attack that would hit it. To do so, the captain must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.

traits.name: Detect Life
traits.desc: The banshee can magically sense the presence of living creatures up to 5 miles away that aren't undead or constructs. She knows the general direction they're in but not their exact locations.

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.desc: The banshee can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. She takes 5 (1d10) force damage if she ends her turn inside an object.

actions.name: Corrupting Touch
actions.desc: ms 4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 (3d6 + 2) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Horrifying Visage
actions.desc: Each non-undead creature within 60 feet of the banshee that can see her must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened for 1 minute. A frightened target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, with disadvantage if the banshee is within line of sight, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a target's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the target is immune to the banshee's Horrifying Visage for the next 24 hours.

actions.name: Wail (1/Day)
actions.desc: The banshee releases a mournful wail, provided that she isn't in sunlight. This wail has no effect on constructs and undead. All other creatures within 30 feet of her that can hear her must make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, a creature drops to 0 hit points. On a success, a creature takes 10 (3d6) psychic damage.

traits.name: Reckless
traits.desc: At the start of its turn, the barlgura can gain advantage on all melee weapon attack rolls it makes during that turn, but attack rolls against it have advantage until the start of its next turn.

traits.name: Running Leap
traits.desc: The barlgura's long jump is up to 40 feet and its high jump is up to 20 feet when it has a running start.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The barlgura makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its fists.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: mw 7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Fist
actions.desc: mw 7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 (1d10 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

traits.name: Petrifying Gaze
traits.desc:
If a creature starts its turn within 30 feet of the basilisk and the two of them can see each other, the basilisk can force the creature to make a DC 12 Constitution saving throw if the basilisk isn't incapacitated. On a failed save, the creature magically begins to turn to stone and is restrained. It must repeat the saving throw at the end of its next turn. On a success, the effect ends. On a failure, the creature is petrified until freed by the greater restoration spell or other magic.

A creature that isn't surprised can avert its eyes to avoid the saving throw at the start of its turn. If it does so, it can't see the basilisk until the start of its next turn, when it can avert its eyes again. If it looks at the basilisk in the meantime, it must immediately make the save.

If the basilisk sees its reflection within 30 feet of it in bright light, it mistakes itself for a rival and targets itself with its gaze.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) poison damage.

traits.name: Burning Touch
traits.desc: An abominable beauty's slam attack deals 28 (8d6) fire damage. A creature that touches it also takes 28 (8d6) fire damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: An abominable beauty makes two slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) damage plus 28 (8d6) fire damage.

actions.name: Blinding Gaze (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: A creature within 30 feet of an abominable beauty that is targeted by this attack and that meets the abominable beauty's gaze must succeed on a DC 17 Charisma saving throw or be blinded. On a success, the creature develops permanent immunity to that abominable beauty's blinding gaze.

actions.name: Deafening Voice (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: An abominable beauty's voice is lovely, but each creature within 90 feet of it that can hear it when it uses its deafening voice attack must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or be permanently deafened.

actions.name: Beak
actions.desc: mw 4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 (1d8 + 2) slashing damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The behir makes two attacks: one with its bite and one to constrict.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: mw 10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}22 (3d10 + 6) piercing damage.

actions.name: Constrict
actions.desc: mw 10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one Large or smaller creature. {@h}17 (2d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage plus 17 (2d10 + 6) slashing damage. The target is grappled (escape DC 16) if the behir isn't already constricting a creature, and the target is restrained until this grapple ends.

actions.name: Lightning Breath {@recharge 5}
actions.desc: The behir exhales a line of lightning that is 20 feet long and 5 feet wide. Each creature in that line must make a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw, taking 66 (12d10) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

actions.name: Swallow
actions.desc:
The behir makes one bite attack against a Medium or smaller target it is grappling. If the attack hits, the target is also swallowed, and the grapple ends. While swallowed, the target is blinded and restrained, it has Cover against attacks and other effects outside the behir, and it takes 21 (6d6) acid damage at the start of each of the behir's turns. A behir can have only one creature swallowed at a time.

If the behir takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from the swallowed creature, the behir must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate the creature, which falls prone in a space within 10 feet of the behir. If the behir dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse by using 15 feet of movement, exiting prone.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Spear
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Fire Breath (Recharge 6)
actions.desc: A behtu exhales fire in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area takes 21 (5d8) fire damage, or half as much damage on a successful DC 13 Dexterity saving throw.

actions.name: Ichor Infusions
actions.desc: War bands of behtus carry 1d6 vials of ichor infusions. They usually drink one before springing an ambush. For 2d6 rounds after drinking one, behtus gain a +4 bonus to their Strength and Constitution scores, and their base speed (including their climbing speed) is quadrupled. During this time, behtus suffer a −4 penalty to their Intelligence and Wisdom scores. A non-behtu character who drinks a behtu infusion is poisoned and takes 10 (3d6) poison damage. On a successful DC 14 Constitution saving throw against poison, the character takes half damage and isn't poisoned.

traits.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
traits.desc: The weasel has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}1 piercing damage.

traits.desc: The weasel has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage.

traits.name: Arctic Hunter
traits.desc: A beli has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) and Wisdom (Perception) checks made in frozen natural environments.

traits.name: Cold Regeneration
traits.desc: While the temperature is below freezing, a beli regains 3 hit points at the start of its turn. If the beli takes fire damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of its next turn. A beli dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

traits.name: Aerial Withdrawal
traits.desc: A beli doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc: A beli's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 12, +4 to hit with spell attacks). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components: At will: invisibility. 3/day: chill touch

actions.name: Ice Dagger
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage plus 2 (1d4) cold damage.

actions.name: Icy Shortbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage plus 2 (1d4) cold damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or gain two levels of exhaustion from the arrow's freezing touch. On a success, the target also becomes immune to further exhaustion effects from beli arrows for 24 hours (however, any levels of exhaustion it has already gained persist). A character who reaches sixth level of exhaustion doesn't die automatically but falls to 0 hit points and makes death saving throws normally. Levels of exhaustion persist until the creature fully recovers from the cold damage.

traits.name: Grasping Hair
traits.desc: A drowned beauty's hair attacks as if it were three separate limbs. Each can be targeted separately (AC 19; 15 hit points; immunity to necrotic, poison, and psychic damage; resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical weapons that aren't silvered). A lock of hair can be broken by a creature that succeeds on a DC 15 Strength check against it as an action.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc: A drowned beauty's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 15). She can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components: At will: disguise self, silence

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The drowned beauty makes two claw attacks and one hair attack. She can replace any of them with a kiss attack.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Hair
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d10 + 3) slashing damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 16). Up to three creatures can be grappled at a time.

actions.name: Kiss
actions.desc: The drowned beauty can kiss a grappled target in an adjacent space. The target must succeed on a DC 15 Charisma saving throw or have its Strength reduced by 1d6.

actions.name: Wrap
actions.desc: The drowned beauty can pull a grappled creature of Large size or smaller up to 15 feet in a straight line toward her.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: A bereginyas makes two claw attacks. If both attacks hit the same target, the target is grappled (escape DC 12), and the bereginyas immediately uses its choke attack as a bonus action.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d8 + 5) slashing damage.

actions.name: Choke
actions.desc: If a bereginyas is grappling an opponent, it uses a bonus action to insert a half-solid, half-gaseous tendril into its victim's throat. The victim must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or immediately be out of breath and start suffocating. The suffocation ends if the victim escapes the grapple or if the bereginyas is killed.

traits.name: Reckless
traits.desc: At the start of its turn, the berserker can gain advantage on all melee weapon attack rolls during that turn, but attack rolls against it have advantage until the start of its next turn.

actions.name: Greataxe
actions.desc: mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 (1d12 + 3) slashing damage.

traits.name: Devil's Sight
traits.desc: Magical darkness doesn't impede the devil's darkvision.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The devil has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The devil makes three melee attacks: two with its fork and one with its tail. It can use Hurl Flame in place of any melee attack.

actions.name: Fork
actions.desc: mw 10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}15 (2d8 + 6) piercing damage.

actions.name: Tail
actions.desc: mw 10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}10 (1d8 + 6) piercing damage. If the target is a creature other than an undead or a construct, it must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or lose 10 (3d6) hit points at the start of each of its turns due to an infernal wound. Each time the devil hits the wounded target with this attack, the damage dealt by the wound increases by 10 (3d6). Any creature can take an action to stanch the wound with a successful DC 12 Wisdom (Medicine) check. The wound also closes if the target receives magical healing.

actions.name: Hurl Flame
actions.desc: rs 7 to hit, range 150 ft., one target. {@h}14 (4d6) fire damage. If the target is a flammable object that isn't being worn or carried, it also catches fire.

traits.name: Amorphous
traits.desc: The shadow beast can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.desc: The shadow beast can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc: The shadow beast uses Charisma as its innate spellcasting ability (spell save DC 15). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components: 3/day each: fear, telekinesis

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The shadow beast has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.desc: While in direct sunlight, the shadow beast has disadvantage on attack rolls and on sight-based Wisdom (Perception) checks.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The shadow beast makes one bite attack and two claw attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) slashing damage.

actions.name: Shadow Push (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: The shadow beast whips its foes with a gust of animated shadows in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in the area of effect must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be pushed 10 feet away and knocked prone.

traits.name: Avoidance
traits.desc: If the displacer beast is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a saving throw to take only half damage, it instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if it fails.

traits.name: Displacement
traits.desc: The displacer beast projects a magical illusion that makes it appear to be standing near its actual location, causing attack rolls against it to have disadvantage. If it is hit by an attack, this trait is disrupted until the end of its next turn. This trait is also disrupted while the displacer beast is incapacitated or has a speed of 0.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The displacer beast makes two attacks with its tentacles.

actions.name: Tentacle
actions.desc: mw 6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}7 (1d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 3 (1d6) piercing damage.

traits.name: Keen Smell
traits.desc: The badger has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

traits.desc: The badger has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The badger makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its claws.
