actions.desc: mw 8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Sting
actions.desc: mw 8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage plus 17 (5d6) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or become poisoned for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

traits.name: Shapechanger
traits.desc: The imp can use its action to polymorph into a beast form that resembles a rat (speed 20 ft.), a raven (20 ft., fly 60 ft.), or a spider (20 ft., climb 20 ft.), or back into its true form. Its statistics are the same in each form, except for the speed changes noted. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

traits.name: Devil's Sight
traits.desc: Magical darkness doesn't impede the imp's darkvision.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The imp has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Sting (Bite in Beast Form)
actions.desc: mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage, and the target must make a DC 11 Constitution saving throw, taking 10 (3d6) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

actions.name: Invisibility
actions.desc: The imp magically turns invisible until it attacks, or until its concentration ends (as if concentration on a spell). Any equipment the imp wears or carries is invisible with it.

traits.name: Fear Aura
traits.desc: Any creature hostile to the pit fiend that starts its turn within 20 feet of the pit fiend must make a DC 21 Wisdom saving throw, unless the pit fiend is incapacitated. On a failed save, the creature is frightened until the start of its next turn. If a creature's saving throw is successful, the creature is immune to the pit fiend's Fear Aura for the next 24 hours.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The pit fiend has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.desc: The pit fiend's weapon attacks are magical.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The pit fiend makes four attacks: one with its bite, one with its claw, one with its mace, and one with its tail.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: mw 14 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}22 (4d6 + 8) piercing damage. The target must succeed on a DC 21 Constitution saving throw or become poisoned. While poisoned in this way, the target can't regain hit points, and it takes 21 (6d6) poison damage at the start of each of its turns. The poisoned target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: mw 14 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}17 (2d8 + 8) slashing damage.

actions.name: Mace
actions.desc: mw 14 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}15 (2d6 + 8) bludgeoning damage plus 21 (6d6) fire damage.

actions.name: Tail
actions.desc: mw 14 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}24 (3d10 + 8) bludgeoning damage.

diaspaad.name: Diaspaad

traits.name: Split
traits.desc: When a Small or larger diaspaad takes at least 25 slashing damage, it splits into two new diaspaads one size category smaller. Each new diaspaad has half the hit points of the diaspaad it split from. They have disadvantage on Strength checks and Strength saving throws. Their damage is reduced by 1 point and one die category per size below Large.

traits.name: Fission
traits.desc: Once per day, if it wishes, a diaspaad can generate another identical diaspaad (same size) by dividing into two parts, each of which regrows into a full creature. The process takes 1 minute, during which the diaspaad is motionless and can do nothing else.

traits.name: Adaptive Damage Resistance
traits.desc: When the diaspaad takes a type of damage, it develops resistance to that damage type for the rest of the combat. Affected damage types are: acid, bludgeoning, fire, lightning, cold, piercing, poison, thunder, slashing. These resistances stack.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.desc: The diaspaad regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 hit point and took no damage it wasn't resistant to since the start of its previous turn.

traits.name: Bodily Fusion
traits.desc: Two Medium or smaller diaspaads can merge to reform a diaspaad one size category larger (Large at most). The process takes 1 minute, during which the two diaspaads are pressed together, motionless, and can do nothing else. If uninterrupted, their bodies fuse and reform the "parent" diaspaad at full hit points in 1d3 rounds.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The diaspaad makes two slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d10+5) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Haste (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: Until the end of its next turn, the diaspaad gains a +2 bonus to AC, has advantage on Dexterity saving throws, and can use its slam attack as a bonus action.

diaspaad.languages: Diaspaad, repeats words without understanding them

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: mw 4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 (2d6 + 2) piercing damage.

traits.name: Amorphous
traits.desc: A dipsa can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

traits.name: Subtle Bite
traits.desc: A dipsa's bite is barely visible, and the wound is quickly anesthetized. A creature that has been bitten must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom (Perception) check to realize it has been attacked or to notice the damage.

traits.name: Translucent
traits.desc: A dipsa can choose to take the Hide action as a bonus action on each of its turns.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 0 ft., one creature in the dipsa's space. Hit: 1 piercing damage, and the dipsa attaches to the target. A creature with a dipsa attached takes 3 (1d6) acid damage per round per dipsa. It must also succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or have its hit point maximum reduced by the damage taken. If the creature's hit point maximum reaches 0 as a result of this effect, it dies. The reduction of the creature's hit point maximum lasts until it is targeted by a lesser restoration spell or comparable magic.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.desc: A dissimortuum can climb any surface, including walking on ceilings, without making an ability check.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: A dissimortuum makes three claw attacks.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (3d8 + 2) slashing damage.

actions.name: Frightening Mask
actions.desc: All non-undead creatures within 60 feet of a dissimortuum that can see it must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened for 1d8 rounds. A target that succeeds on its saving throw, or for which the effect ends, is immune to the effect of all frightening masks for the next 24 hours.

traits.name: Elemental Demise
traits.desc: If the djinni dies, its body disintegrates into a warm breeze, leaving behind only equipment the djinni was wearing or carrying.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The djinni makes three scimitar attacks.

actions.name: Scimitar
actions.desc: mw 9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) lightning or thunder damage (djinni's choice).

actions.name: Create Whirlwind
actions.desc:
A 5-foot-radius, 30-foot-tall cylinder of swirling air magically forms on a point the djinni can see within 120 feet of it. The whirlwind lasts as long as the djinni maintains concentration (as if concentration on a spell). Any creature but the djinni that enters the whirlwind must succeed on a DC 18 Strength saving throw or be restrained by it. The djinni can move the whirlwind up to 60 feet as an action, and creatures restrained by the whirlwind move with it. The whirlwind ends if the djinni loses sight of it.

A creature can use its action to free a creature restrained by the whirlwind, including itself, by succeeding on a DC 18 Strength check. If the check succeeds, the creature is no longer restrained and moves to the nearest space outside the whirlwind.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: A domovoi makes two slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

traits.name: Shapechanger
traits.desc: The doppelganger can use its action to polymorph into a Small or Medium humanoid it has seen, or back into its true form. Its statistics, other than its size, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

traits.name: Ambusher
traits.desc: In the first round of a combat, the doppelganger has advantage on attack rolls against any creature it surprised.

traits.name: Surprise Attack
traits.desc: If the doppelganger surprises a creature and hits it with an attack during the first round of combat, the target takes an extra 10 (3d6) damage from the attack.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The doppelganger makes two melee attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: mw 6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 (1d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Read Thoughts
actions.desc: The doppelganger magically reads the surface thoughts of one creature within 60 feet of it. The effect can penetrate barriers, but 3 feet of wood or dirt, 2 feet of stone, 2 inches of metal, or a thin sheet of lead blocks it. While the target is in range, the doppelganger can continue reading its thoughts, as long as the doppelganger's concentration isn't broken (as if concentration on a spell). While reading the target's mind, the doppelganger has advantage on Wisdom (Insight) and Charisma (Deception, Intimidation, and Persuasion) checks against the target.

traits.name: Keen Smell
traits.desc: A doppelrat has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 piercing damage.

actions.name: Arcane Duplication (Recharges after 10 Minutes)
actions.desc: A doppelrat that feels threatened creates clones at the start of its turn. Each round for 4 rounds, the number of living doppelrats is multiplied by four, up to a maximum of 20. For example, when a doppelrat triggers its arcane duplication power, 1 rat becomes 4. At the start of its next turn, those 4 rats become 16, then 20 (the maximum allowed) at the start of its third turn. If one of the clones is destroyed between the original doppelrat's first and second turns, the 3 surviving rats become 12, and so on. Each clone appears in the same space as its original and can either move or take an action during the round it appears. Each has 4 hit points and AC 13. All surviving clones perish 1 minute (10 rounds) after the first clones were created. If the original doppelrat dies, the clones stop duplicating, but those already created persist until the scheduled end of their existence. A creature can distinguish the original doppelrat from its clones as an action, by succeeding on a DC 15 Intelligence (Nature) or Wisdom (Perception) check.

actions.name: Doppel Disease
actions.desc: At the end of an encounter with a doppelrat, all creatures bitten by it or by one of its clones must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or contract degenerative cloning disease. During each long rest, the diseased creature creates and expels a stillborn clone. The cloning process leaves the diseased creature incapacitated for 1 hour, during which it is unable to move and barely able to speak (it can't cast spells in this state). When it leaves this state, the creature must make a DC 12 Constitution saving throw. If it succeeds on this saving throw twice in a row, it is cured of the disease. Humanoid clones created as a result of this disease can't be brought to life in any way.

traits.desc: This power functions like tree stride, but the dorreq can use it to disappear and reappear in a space covered with sand or scree, with a range of 30 feet. If it uses this power, the dorreq forgoes its normal movement.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: A dorreq makes two tentacle attacks and one bite attack. If both tentacle attacks hit their target, the target is grappled (escape DC 14).

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (4d8 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Tentacle
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage. If both tentacles hit the same target in the same turn, the target is grappled (escape DC 14) and pulled within reach of the bite attack if it was more than 5 feet from the dorreq. A target can be pulled this way only if it is Large or smaller. A dorreq can grapple one Large creature, two Medium creatures, or two Small creatures at the same time.

actions.name: Entangle
actions.desc: Any creature that starts its turn within 10 feet of the dorreq must succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity check at the start of each of its turns or be entangled by the dorreq's tentacles until the start of its next turn. On its turn, the dorreq can freely choose to ignore or release a creature in this area of effect.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If Zikzokrishka fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance

actions.desc: Zikzokrishka can use its Frightful Presence. It then makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws.

actions.name: Frightful Presence
actions.desc: Each creature of Zikzokrishka's choice that is within 120 feet of the Zikzokrishka and aware of it must succeed on a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened for 1 minute. legendaryActions.name: Detect

legendaryActions.name: Tail Attack

legendaryActions.desc: Zikzokrishka beats its tattered wings. Red—5 years or less

Orange—6–10 years

Yellow—11–20 years

Green—21–30 years

Blue—31–40 years

Indigo—41–50 years

Violet—51 years or more

A green or older faerie dragon's CR increases to 2.

If the snail succeeds on its saving throw against a spell or a spell's attack roll misses it, the snail's shell converts some of the spell's energy into a burst of destructive force if the spell is of 1st level or higher; each creature within 30 feet of the snail must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw, taking 3 (1d6) force damage per level of the spell on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

The spark instantly enters the target's space and merges with its physical form. While it inhabits a creature, it takes no damage from physical attacks. The target creature gains a +4 bonus to Dexterity and Charisma while inhabited. Creatures with passive Perception 14 or higher find the host's words and deeds jerky and erratic. Each time the spark uses its innate spellcasting, its host is entitled to a new DC 14 Charisma saving throw. On a success, it expels the spark, which appears in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of it. Once installed, the spark slowly burns its host's nervous system; the host must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw every 24 hours. On each failure, it takes 2d6 lightning damage and has its hit point maximum reduced by the same amount. If this effect reduces its hit point maximum to 0, it dies. languages: Any languages it knew in life

traits.name: Ethereal Sight
traits.desc: Ebondeath can see 60 feet into the Ethereal Plane when it is on the Material Plane, and vice versa.

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.desc: Ebondeath can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If the dragon fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Withering Touch
actions.desc: mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}17 (4d6 + 3) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Etherealness
actions.desc: Ebondeath enters the Ethereal Plane from the Material Plane, or vice versa. It is visible on the Material Plane while it is in the Border Ethereal, and vice versa, yet it can't affect or be affected by anything on the other plane.

actions.name: Horrifying Visage
actions.desc: Each non-undead creature within 60 feet of Ebondeath that can see it must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened for 1 minute. If the save fails by 5 or more, the target also ages 1d4 × 10 years. A frightened target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the frightened condition on itself on a success. If a target's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the target is immune to this Ebondeath's Horrifying Visage for the next 24 hours. The aging effect can be reversed with a greater restoration spell, but only within 24 hours of it occurring.

actions.name: Possession {@recharge}
actions.desc:
One humanoid that Ebondeath can see within 5 feet of it must succeed on a DC 20 Charisma saving throw or be possessed by Ebondeath; Ebondeath then disappears, and the target is incapacitated and loses control of its body. Ebondeath now controls the body but doesn't deprive the target of awareness. Ebondeath can't be targeted by any attack, spell, or other effect, except ones that turn undead, and it retains its alignment, Intelligence, Wisdom, Charisma, and immunity to being charmed and frightened. It otherwise uses the possessed target's statistics, including gaining access to the target's knowledge, class features, and proficiencies.

The possession lasts until the body drops to 0 hit points, Ebondeath ends it as a bonus action, or Ebondeath is turned or forced out by an effect like the dispel evil and good spell. When the possession ends, Ebondeath reappears in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the body. The target is immune to Ebondeath Possession for 24 hours after succeeding on the saving throw or after the possession ends.

At will: calm emotions, charm animal (as charm person, but affects only beasts), cure wounds, detect poison and disease, water breathing, water walk. 3/day each: barkskin, conjure woodland beings, hold animal (as hold person, but affects only beasts), jump, longstrider. 1/day each: commune with nature, freedom of movement, nondetection, tree stride

On a success, the water evaporates and the golem continues to function normally; on a failure, its flame goes out and its boiler loses pressure. The golem then acts as if under the effect of the slow spell for 1d3 rounds and is then paralyzed until its fire is relit and it has spent 15 minutes building up pressure.

traits.desc:
Any humanoid that starts its turn within 30 feet of the hag and can see the hag's true form must make a DC 11 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature is frightened for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, with disadvantage if the hag is within line of sight, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the hag's Horrific Appearance for the next 24 hours.

Unless the target is surprised or the revelation of the hag's true form is sudden, the target can avert its eyes and avoid making the initial saving throw. Until the start of its next turn, a creature that averts its eyes has disadvantage on attack rolls against the hag.

The hag covers herself and anything she is wearing or carrying with a magical illusion that makes her look like an ugly creature of her general size and humanoid shape. The effect ends if the hag takes a bonus action to end it or if she dies.

The changes wrought by this effect fail to hold up to physical inspection. For example, the hag could appear to have no claws, but someone touching her hand might feel the claws. Otherwise, a creature must take an action to visually inspect the illusion and succeed on a DC 16 Intelligence (Investigation) check to discern that the hag is disguised.

traits.desc:
A night hag carries two very rare magic items that she must craft for herself. If either object is lost, the night hag will go to great lengths to retrieve it, as creating a new tool takes time and effort.

Heartstone.
This lustrous black gem allows a night hag to become ethereal while it is in her possession. The touch of a heartstone also cures any disease. Crafting a heartstone takes 30 days.

Soul Bag.
When an evil humanoid dies as a result of a night hag's Nightmare Haunting, the hag catches the soul in this black sack made of stitched flesh. A soul bag can hold only one evil soul at a time, and only the night hag who crafted the bag can catch a soul with it. Crafting a soul bag takes 7 days and a humanoid sacrifice (whose flesh is used to make the bag).

traits.name: Blood Sense
traits.desc: A blood hag automatically perceives the blood of living creatures within 90 feet and pinpoints their exact location within 30 feet.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc: The blood hag uses Charisma as her innate spellcasting ability (spell save DC 15). She can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components: At will: disguise self, knock, minor illusion, misty step, pass without trace, protection from evil and good, tongues, water breathing. 3/day each: bestow curse, invisibility, mirror image. 1/day each: cloudkill, modify memory

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The blood hag makes two claw attacks and one blood-drinking hair attack.

actions.name: Blood-Drinking Hair
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (3d8 + 5) piercing damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, it is grappled (escape DC 15). A grappled creature takes 13 (2d8 + 3) necrotic damage at the start of the hag's turn. The hag recovers half that amount as hit points. Excess hit points become temporary hit points. The hag can grapple one or two creatures at a time. See also Tear Off Face.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (4d6 + 5) slashing damage.

actions.name: Call Blood
actions.desc: The blood hag targets a living creature within 30 feet that she has pinpointed with Blood Sense and causes a hemorrhage. The target must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or suffer one of the effects listed below. On a success, this hag's power doesn't affect it for 24 hours. 1. Blood Choke. The target's mouth fills with blood, preventing it from speaking or casting a spell with a verbal component for 1 minute. 2. Blood Eye. The target's eyes fill with tears of blood. It is blinded for 1 minute. 3. Thundering Pulse. The target hears nothing but the flow of blood and the beating of its heart. It is deafened for 1 minute. 4. Arterial Rupture. The victim takes 7 (2d6) slashing damage as its veins and arteries tear. The target repeats the saving throw at the start of each of its turns. On a failure, it takes 3 (1d6) necrotic damage; on a success, it ends the effect.

actions.name: Tear Off Face
actions.desc: The blood hag tears off the face of a grappled opponent. The victim must make a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, the hag rips off its face, dealing it 38 (8d6 + 10) slashing damage. The victim is then stunned until the start of the hag's next turn. If the target succeeds on its save, it takes half damage and isn't stunned. Heal, regenerate, and similar magic restores the stolen features; other forms of healing magic leave a mass of scar tissue. The torn-off face is a Tiny animated object (as the spell, 20 hp, AC 18, no attack, STR 4, DEX 18) under the hag's control. It retains the memories and personality of its previous owner. Blood hags keep these faces as trophies, but they can also wear them to gain advantage on a Charisma (Deception) check to impersonate the face's previous owner.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.desc: The hag can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Mimicry (Green Hag)
traits.desc: The hag can mimic animal sounds and humanoid voices. A creature that hears the sounds can tell they are imitations with a successful DC 14 Wisdom (Insight) check.

actions.name: Illusory Appearance
actions.desc: The hag covers herself with a magical illusion that allows her to look like another creature of her general size and shape. The illusion ends when the hag chooses, or if she dies. A DC 20 Intelligence (Investigation) check will expose the hag's disguise.

actions.name: Invisible Passage
actions.desc: The hag magically turns invisible until she attacks or casts a spell, or until her concentration ends. While invisible, she leaves no physical evidence of her passage, and can only be tracked by magic.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: mw 6 to hit, one target. {@h}17 (2d8 + 4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Sting
actions.desc: mw 4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage, and the target must make a DC 11 Constitution saving throw, taking 10 (3d6) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If the poison damage reduces the target to 0 hit points, the target is stable but poisoned for 1 hour, even after regaining hit points, and is paralyzed while poisoned in this way.

traits.name: Dwarven Resilience
traits.desc: The dwarf has advantage on saving throws against poison.

actions.name: Handaxe
actions.desc: mw,rw 3 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}4 (1d6 + 1) slashing damage.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.desc: The warrior has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the warrior's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

actions.name: Spear
actions.desc: mw,rw 3 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}4 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage, or 5 (1d8 + 1) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

traits.name: Giant Strength
traits.desc: A gug can lift up to 2 tons as a bonus action.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The gug makes two fist attacks, two stomp attacks, or one of each.

actions.name: Fist
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. Hit: 16 (2d8 + 7) bludgeoning damage. If a creature is hit by this attack twice in the same turn, the victim must succeed on a DC 19 Constitution saving throw or gain one level of exhaustion.

actions.name: Stomp
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 10 ft. Hit: 20 (2d12 + 7) bludgeoning damage.

legendaryActions.name: Move
legendaryActions.desc: The gug moves up to half its speed.

legendaryActions.name: Attack
legendaryActions.desc: The gug makes one fist or stomp attack.

legendaryActions.name: Grab
legendaryActions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: the target is grappled (escape DC 17).

legendaryActions.name: Swallow
legendaryActions.desc: The gug swallows a creature it has grappled. The creature immediately takes 26 (3d12 + 7) bludgeoning damage plus 13 (2d12) acid damage at the start of each of the gug's turns. A swallowed creature is no longer grappled, but it is blinded and restrained and has total cover against attacks and effects coming from outside the gug. If the gug takes 75 damage in a single turn, it spits out the swallowed creature, which falls prone next to it. When the gug dies, a swallowed creature can crawl out of its corpse by spending 10 feet of movement.

legendaryActions.name: Throw
legendaryActions.desc: The gug throws a creature it has grappled. The creature is hurled a distance of 2d4 x 10 feet in a direction of the gug's choice and takes 20 (2d12 + 7) bludgeoning damage (plus falling damage if it is thrown into a pit or off a cliff). A gug can throw a creature of Large size at most. It throws Small creatures twice as far, but the damage remains the same.

traits.name: Inscrutable
traits.desc: The sphinx is immune to any effect that would sense its emotions or read its thoughts, as well as any divination spell that it refuses. Wisdom (Insight) checks made to ascertain the sphinx's intentions or sincerity have disadvantage.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.desc: The sphinx's weapon attacks are magical.

actions.name: Multiattack

actions.desc: mw 8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 (2d8 + 4) slashing damage.

legendaryActions.name: Cast a Spell (Costs 3 Actions)

traits.name: Regeneration

A denizen of Leng dies only if it starts a turn at 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate. Even if killed, its body reforms in a Leng crypt, and it then resumes the normal course of its life.

traits.name: Void Gaze
traits.desc: As a bonus action, a denizen of Leng can see through doors and around corners. It is therefore very hard to surprise.

traits.name: Void Sailors
traits.desc: Denizens of Leng can cross the anaerobic void without harm.

In addition, ethereal harpoon attacks ignore armor. Only the Dexterity modifier incorporated in the target's AC is taken into account.

actions.name: Psychic Scimitar

actions.name: Luring Song
actions.desc:
The harpy sings a magical melody. Every humanoid and giant within 300 feet of the harpy that can hear the song must succeed on a DC 11 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed until the song ends. The harpy must take a bonus action on its subsequent turns to continue singing. It can stop singing at any time. The song ends if the harpy is incapacitated.

While charmed by the harpy, a target is incapacitated and ignores the songs of other harpies. If the charmed target is more than 5 feet away from the harpy, the target must move on its turn toward the harpy by the most direct route. It doesn't avoid opportunity attacks, but before moving into damaging terrain, such as lava or a pit, and whenever it takes damage from a source other than the harpy, a target can repeat the saving throw. A creature can also repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns. If a creature's saving throw is successful, the effect ends on it.

A target that successfully saves is immune to this harpy's song for the next 24 hours.

traits.name: Dissonance
traits.desc: The owl harpy can't use its blindsight while deafened.

actions.name: Drifting Darkness
actions.desc: A hovering owl harpy can drop a fine magical dust from its wings onto a creature 20 feet or less directly below it. The creature must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or fall unconscious and poisoned for 10 minutes. It wakes up if it takes damage or if a creature uses its action to wake it up. Waking doesn't remove the poison.

actions.name: Luring Song
actions.desc: The owl harpy sings a magical melody. All humanoids and giants within 300 feet that can hear the song must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed until the song ends. The harpy must use a bonus action on its subsequent turns to keep singing. It can stop at any time. The song ends if the harpy is incapacitated. While charmed by the harpy, a target is incapacitated and ignores the song of other harpies. If it moves more than 5 feet away from the harpy, it must move at its maximum speed (dashing if necessary) by the shortest route to get within 5 feet of the harpy. It doesn't maneuver to avoid opportunity attacks, but it can repeat the saving throw each time it takes damage from a source other than the harpy. It repeats the saving throw before entering dangerous terrain (such as lava or a pit) if the most direct route includes a dangerous area. It also repeats it at the end of each of its turns. A successful saving throw ends the effect on the creature and makes it immune to that harpy's song for 24 hours.

haugbui.name: Vampire
languages: the languages it knew in life

traits.name: Shapechanger
traits.desc:
If the vampire isn't in sunlight or running water, it can use its action to polymorph into a Tiny bat or a Medium cloud of mist, or back into its true form.

While in bat form, the vampire can't speak, its walking speed is 5 feet, and it has a flying speed of 30 feet. Its statistics, other than its size and speed, are unchanged. Anything it is wearing transforms with it, but nothing it is carrying does. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

While in mist form, the vampire can't take any actions, speak, or manipulate objects. It is weightless, has a flying speed of 20 feet, can hover, and can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. In addition, if air can pass through a space, the mist can do so without squeezing, and it can't pass through water. It has advantage on Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution saving throws, and it is immune to all nonmagical damage, except the damage it takes from sunlight.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If the vampire fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Misty Escape
traits.desc:
When it drops to 0 hit points outside its resting place, the vampire transforms into a cloud of mist (as in the Shapechanger trait) instead of falling unconscious, provided that it isn't in sunlight or running water. If it can't transform, it is destroyed.

While it has 0 hit points in mist form, it can't revert to its vampire form, and it must reach its resting place within 2 hours or be destroyed. Once in its resting place, it reverts to its vampire form. It is then paralyzed until it regains at least 1 hit point. After spending 1 hour in its resting place with 0 hit points, it regains 1 hit point.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.desc: The vampire regains 20 hit points at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 hit point and isn't in sunlight or running water. If the vampire takes radiant damage or damage from Holy Water (Flask), this trait doesn't function at the start of the vampire's next turn.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.desc: The vampire can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Vampire Weaknesses

actions.name: Multiattack (Vampire Form Only)
actions.desc: The vampire makes two attacks, only one of which can be a bite attack.

actions.name: Unarmed Strike (Vampire Form Only)
actions.desc: mw 9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}8 (1d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage. Instead of dealing damage, the vampire can grapple the target (escape DC 18).

actions.name: Bite (Bat or Vampire Form Only)
actions.desc: mw 9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one willing creature, or a creature that is grappled by the vampire, incapacitated, or restrained. {@h}7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) necrotic damage. The target's hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the necrotic damage taken, and the vampire regains hit points equal to that amount. The reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its hit point maximum to 0. A humanoid slain in this way and then buried in the ground rises the following night as a vampire spawn under the vampire's control.

actions.name: Charm
actions.desc:
The vampire targets one humanoid it can see within 30 feet of it. If the target can see the vampire, the target must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw against this magic or be charmed by the vampire. The charmed target regards the vampire as a trusted friend to be heeded and protected. Although the target isn't under the vampire's control, it takes the vampire's requests or actions in the most favorable way it can, and it is a willing target for the vampire's bite attack.

Each time the vampire or the vampire's companions do anything harmful to the target, it can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success. Otherwise, the effect lasts 24 hours or until the vampire is destroyed, is on a different plane of existence than the target, or takes a bonus action to end the effect.

actions.name: Children of the Night (1/Day)
actions.desc: The vampire magically calls 2d4 swarms of swarm of bats or swarm of rats, provided that the sun isn't up. While outdoors, the vampire can call 3d6 wolf instead. The called creatures arrive in 1d4 rounds, acting as allies of the vampire and obeying its spoken commands. The beasts remain for 1 hour, until the vampire dies, or until the vampire dismisses them as a bonus action.

traits.name: Corrupting Touch
traits.desc: A herald of darkness can destroy any object of wood, leather, copper, iron, or paper by touching it as a bonus action. An ordinary object is automatically destroyed; a magic item is destroyed if its bearer fails a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw.

traits.name: Gift of Darkness
traits.desc: As an action, the herald of darkness can transform a fey, a human, or a goblin into a shadow fey, if the target accepts the transformation.

traits.name: Shadow Form
traits.desc: A herald of darkness can turn into an intangible shadow as a bonus action. In this form, it has a flying speed of 10 feet, can enter and occupy a space occupied by another creature, gains resistance to all nonmagical damage, has advantage on physical saving throws, can pass through any gap or opening, and can't attack, interact with physical objects, or speak. It can resume tangible form as a bonus action.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The herald of darkness uses Abyssal Majesty if available and makes one melee attack.

actions.name: Embrace Darkness
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., all creatures in reach. Hit: 6 (1d12) necrotic damage. Targets are paralyzed until the start of the herald's next turn. A DC 17 Constitution saving throw negates the paralysis.

actions.name: Abyssal Majesty (Recharge 4–6)
actions.desc: The herald of darkness emits a sinister burst of infernal power. All creatures within 30 feet in the herald's field of vision take 19 (3d12) necrotic damage and must make a DC 17 Constitution saving throw. Those that fail are blinded for 2 rounds; the others are frightened for 2 rounds.

actions.name: Shadow Sword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (2d12 + 5) slashing damage.

traits.name: Blood Armor
traits.desc: Each round, the herald of blood takes no damage or other effects from the first attack that targets it.

traits.name: Gift of Blood
traits.desc: As an action, the herald of blood can transform a fey, a human, or a goblin into a red hag, if the target accepts the transformation.

traits.name: Grant Blood Rage
traits.desc: As a bonus action, the herald of blood plunges a single living creature into a blood rage, giving it advantage on attacks for 3 rounds. Afterward, it gains one level of exhaustion and takes 13 (2d12) necrotic damage from blood loss.

traits.name: Humanoid Form
traits.desc: A herald of blood can, at will, take a humanoid form as a bonus action and revoke it.

traits.name: Melting Touch
traits.desc: When a herald of blood scores a critical hit or starts its turn grappling an opponent, it can dissolve one wood or metal object of its choice in that opponent's possession. An ordinary object is automatically destroyed; a magic item is destroyed if its bearer fails a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw.

actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (2d12 + 6) slashing damage. The target must succeed on a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw, or the herald of blood grapples it (escape DC 16). A creature grappled this way takes 39 (6d12) acid damage at the start of each of the herald's turns. The herald has no limit to the number of creatures it can grapple this way.

traits.desc: The divine idol can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

traits.name: Stealth in Shadows
traits.desc: When the idol is in darkness or dim light, it can take the Hide action as a bonus action.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The divine idol uses Seduce the Virtuous and makes two slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage plus 18 (4d8) psychic damage.

actions.name: Seduce the Virtuous
actions.desc: The idol targets a humanoid creature it can see within 30 feet. The target has disadvantage on attack rolls, saving throws, or ability checks (the idol's choice) until the end of its next turn. If the target benefits from the protection from evil and good spell or a magic circle, this effect doesn't apply.

isonade.name: Isonade
isonade.languages: understands Aquan and Celestial but can't speak

traits.name: Atmospheric Immunity
traits.desc: The isonade lives comfortably at any ocean depth and suffers no depth-related penalties.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The isonade has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Water Breathing
traits.desc: The isonade can breathe only underwater.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc: The isonade uses Wisdom as its innate spellcasting ability (spell save DC 16). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components: At will: animal messenger. 3/day each: control water, earthquake. 1/day each: control weather, storm of vengeance, tsunami

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: An isonade makes one tail attack and one bite attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 42 (5d12 + 10) piercing damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 20). If the target is already grappled from a previous bite, it is swallowed (see below).

actions.name: Tail Slap
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 31 (6d6 + 10) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Leap out of the Water
actions.desc: The isonade bursts out of the water and slams down on a target with devastating effect. It must move 30 feet in a straight line toward its target before leaping. When it leaps, it rises at most 30 feet into the air before landing. A creature in the isonade's landing zone takes 76 (12d10 + 10) bludgeoning damage and ends up submerged 10 feet underwater. A target that succeeds on a DC 20 Strength saving throw takes only half damage and ends up in the nearest unoccupied space instead of being submerged. Boats and structures aren't immune to this attack.

actions.name: Swallow
actions.desc: When the isonade's bite attack hits a target already grappled by a previous bite attack, that target is swallowed. The grapple ends, but the target is blinded and restrained, has total cover against attacks and effects coming from outside the isonade, and takes 36 (8d8) acid damage at the start of each of the isonade's turns. The isonade can have two Large, four Medium, or six Small creatures swallowed at a time. If a swallowed creature deals 40 damage or more to the isonade in a single turn, the isonade must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution saving throw or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which fall prone within 10 feet of it. If the isonade dies, swallowed creatures are no longer restrained and can escape by spending 20 feet of movement, exiting prone.

traits.name: Camouflage
traits.desc: The jaculi has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide.

traits.name: Keen Smell
traits.desc: The jaculi has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: mw 4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 (2d6 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Spring
actions.desc: The jaculi springs up to 30 feet in a straight line and makes a bite attack against a target within its reach. This attack has advantage if the jaculi springs at least 10 feet. If the attack hits, the bite deals an extra 7 (2d6) piercing damage.

traits.name: Spearhead
traits.desc: If the jaculus moves at least 10 feet in a straight line toward a target and hits it with a jaws attack in the same turn, the attack deals an extra 4 (1d8) piercing damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The jaculus makes one jaws attack and one claw attack.

actions.name: Jaws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d4 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 2) slashing damage.

juggernaut-de-pierre.name: Stone Juggernaut
juggernaut-de-pierre.speed: walk {'number': 50, 'condition': '(in one direction chosen at the start of its turn)'}

traits.name: Devastating Roll
traits.desc: The juggernaut can move through the space of a prone creature. A creature whose space the juggernaut enters for the first time on a turn must make a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw, taking 55 (10d10) bludgeoning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.desc: The juggernaut is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.desc: As long as it has 1 hit point left, the juggernaut magically regains all its hit points daily at dawn. The juggernaut is destroyed and doesn't regenerate if it drops to 0 hit points.

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.desc: The juggernaut deals double damage to objects and structures.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: mw 10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}25 (3d12 + 6) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it must succeed on a DC 17 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

traits.name: Extinguish Flames
traits.desc: A kalke can extinguish candles, lamps, lanterns, and smoldering campfires within 120 feet as a bonus action.

traits.name: Detect Spellcasting
traits.desc: A kalke perceives spellcasting within 5 miles, as long as the effect isn't innate.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: A kalke has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage.

traits.name: Keen Smell
traits.desc: The kamadan has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

traits.name: Pounce
traits.desc: If the kamadan moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a claw attack on the same turn that target must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is knocked prone, the kamadan can make two attacks—one with its bite and one with its snakes—against it as a bonus action.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The kamadan makes two attacks: one with its bite or claw and one with its snakes.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Snakes
actions.desc: mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage, and the target must make a DC 12 Constitution saving throw, taking 21 (6d6) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

actions.name: Sleep Breath (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
actions.desc: The kamadan exhales sleep gas in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or fall unconscious for 10 minutes. This effect ends for a creature if it takes damage or someone uses an action to wake it.

kenku.name: Kenku
languages: understands Auran and Common but speaks only through the use of its Mimicry trait

traits.name: Ambusher
traits.desc: In the first round of a combat, the kenku has advantage on attack rolls against any creature it surprised.

traits.name: Mimicry
traits.desc: The kenku can mimic any sounds it has heard, including voices. A creature that hears the sounds can tell they are imitations with a successful DC 14 Wisdom (Insight) check.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.desc: mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Shortbow
actions.desc: rw 5 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. {@h}6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The kikimora has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc: The kikimora uses Charisma as her innate spellcasting ability (spell save DC 15). She can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components: At will: invisibility (self only), mage hand, mending, minor illusion, prestidigitation. 3/day each: friendship with animals, blinding smite, sleep. 1/day each: insect plague, major image

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The kikimora makes two claw attacks.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Hideaway
actions.desc: When a kikimora chooses a house to settle in, she scrawls a symbol on a wall, baseboard, cupboard, or semi-permanent object (such as a stove) to make it her little domain. This power creates a hidden extradimensional dwelling. Once the kikimora has created her hideaway, she can teleport to it, along with 50 lbs. of objects, instead of moving normally. Only the kikimora, or a creature using the plane shift spell or trait, can reach it. The hideaway's location can be determined by casting detect magic on the symbol's area, but reaching it by plane shifting requires a successful DC 15 Intelligence (Arcana) check. Once inside her hideaway, the kikimora can see what is happening outside thanks to a special sensor. It functions like a window and can be blocked by placing an ordinary object in front of the symbol. If the kikimora places an object in her hideaway, it remains there even if she erases the symbol and redraws it elsewhere. If someone else erases the symbol, all the hideaway's contents spill into the Ethereal Plane (including any creatures there at that moment). In that case, the kikimora can attempt a Charisma saving throw to eject herself into a space adjacent to the symbol (but her possessions don't come with her).

kishi.name: Kishi
kishi.languages: Celestial, Common, Draconic, Infernal, telepathy 120 ft.

traits.name: Two-Headed
traits.desc: The demon has advantage on Perception checks and on saving throws against being blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, stunned, and unconscious.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc:
The demon's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 17). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
At will: detect magic, detect evil and good, suggestion
3/day: glibness
1/day: dominate person

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The demon has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Trophy Shield
traits.desc: If the kishi kills an opponent during its turn, it can use a bonus action to harvest part of the victim's essence along with a gruesome trophy, which it mounts on its shield. For 24 hours, the kishi's Armor Class becomes 20, and creatures of the same race as its victim have disadvantage on attack rolls against the kishi.

traits.name: Summon Demon (1/Day)
traits.desc: A kishi has a 35 percent chance of summoning another kishi.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The demon makes one bite attack and three spear attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) piercing damage.

actions.name: Spear
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage, or 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.desc: While in sunlight, the kobold has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.desc: The kobold has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the kobold's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

actions.desc: mw 4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Sling
actions.desc: rw 4 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. {@h}4 (1d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

traits.desc: While in sunlight, the kobold has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.desc: The kobold has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the kobold's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.desc: mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Dropped Rock
actions.desc: rw 5 to hit, one target directly below the kobold. {@h}6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

traits.name: Apothecary
traits.desc: As a bonus action, the kobold can choose one of the following damage types: acid, cold, or fire. It has resistance to damage of the chosen type until it uses this ability again. In addition, it is proficient with the poisoner's kit.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.desc: The kobold has advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the kobold's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.desc: While in sunlight, the kobold has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The kobold makes two attacks.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage plus 5 (2d4) poison damage.

actions.name: Dart
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage plus 5 (2d4) poison damage.

actions.name: Alchemical Protection (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
actions.desc: The kobold chooses up to six allied creatures within 10 feet. It releases alchemical vapors that give them resistance to poison damage for 10 minutes. Alternatively, it can grant them resistance to the same damage type currently active from its Apothecary trait.

actions.name: Explosive Flask (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: The kobold hurls a flask of volatile substance at a point within 30 feet. It explodes in a 15-foot radius. Creatures in the area take 17 (5d6) poison damage and are poisoned for 1 minute. A creature that succeeds on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw takes only half damage and isn't poisoned. A poisoned creature repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the poison on a success. Instead of poison damage, the kobold can deal damage of the same type as the one currently active from its Apothecary trait.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.desc: The kobold chieftain has advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the chieftain's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.desc: While in sunlight, the kobold chieftain has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

traits.name: Spike-Shooting Shield (5/Rest)
traits.desc: When the kobold chieftain is hit by a melee attack within 5 feet of it, it can fire one of its shield's spikes at the attacker. The attacker takes 3 (1d6) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) poison damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The kobold makes two attacks.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) poison damage. The target must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute. A poisoned creature repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the poison on a success.

actions.name: Shortbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) poison damage. The target must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute. A poisoned creature repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the poison on a success.

actions.name: Inspiring Presence (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
actions.desc: The chieftain chooses up to six allied kobolds it can see within 30 feet of it. For the next minute, they are immune to being charmed or frightened, and they add the chieftain's Charisma bonus to their attack rolls.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.desc: The kobold has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the kobold's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.desc: While in sunlight, the kobold has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The kobold makes two Dagger or Chromatic Bolt attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.desc: mw,rw 4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Chromatic Bolt
actions.desc: rs 4 to hit, range 60 feet, one target. {@h}9 (2d6 + 2) of a type of the kobold's choice: acid, cold, fire, lightning, poison, or thunder.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.desc: While in sunlight, the kobold trapsmith has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.desc: The kobold trapsmith has advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the trapsmith's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

traits.name: Thieves' Tools
traits.desc: The trapsmith is proficient with thieves' tools and rarely parts with them. If it loses its tools or has them stolen, it can craft new ones from wire, scrap metal, and other debris in 30 minutes.

traits.name: Traps and Snares
traits.desc:
The kobold trapsmith excels at setting mechanical traps. Detecting, disarming, avoiding, or mitigating one of its traps requires a successful DC 13 check or saving throw. Each trap has a +5 attack bonus. If the trapsmith has thieves' tools and basic construction materials, it can install one of the simple but effective traps below in 5 minutes. Triggers include pressure plates, tripwires, tumblers on a lock, or other simple mechanisms.
Suffocation Bomb. This small incendiary object burns rapidly and gives off choking smoke in a 20-foot sphere. Visibility within is nil. Any breathing creature in the area when the cloud is released, or that starts its turn there, is poisoned. Once a poisoned creature leaves the cloud, it must make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw at the end of each of its turns. It stops being poisoned as soon as it succeeds on one. The smoke dissipates after 10 minutes or after 1 round of strong wind.
Poisoned Shard. A poisoned shard or needle can hide anywhere: in a lock or a box, under a rug, under a door handle, in a full glass, or in a bowl of gems. As soon as a creature meets the conditions to be pricked, the trap makes a melee attack with advantage: +5 to hit, reach 0 ft., one target. Hit: 2 (1d4) piercing damage plus 14 (4d6) poison damage, or half as much poison damage on a successful DC 13 Constitution saving throw.
Skull Cracker. This trap consists of a weight, spike, or blade designed to fall on a victim or cut it down. When triggered, it makes a melee weapon attack against the first target in its path: +5 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d10) damage. The damage type depends on the skull cracker's design: a stone or heavy log deals bludgeoning damage, a spike-studded trunk deals piercing damage, a scythe blade deals slashing damage, and so on.
Slip Snare. A concealed loop of rope or wire is attached to a counterweight. When a creature steps into the loop, it must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or be hoisted into the air and left hanging upside down 5 feet above the ground. It is then restrained (escape DC 13). The rope has AC 10 and 5 hit points.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Light Crossbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) poison damage, or half as much poison damage on a successful DC 13 Constitution saving throw.

actions.name: Crusher (Recharge 6)
actions.desc: The trapsmith arms a device and hurls it at a point within 30 feet. The device explodes as soon as it touches something solid, sending sharp spikes flying in a 15-foot-radius sphere. Creatures in the area take 14 (4d6) piercing damage, or half as much on a successful DC 13 Dexterity saving throw. The ground in the spherical area is strewn with spikes; it becomes difficult terrain. A creature that falls prone there takes 7 (2d6) piercing damage.

actions.name: Stunner (1/Day)
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage, and the target is restrained (escape DC 13). While restrained, it takes 7 (2d6) lightning damage at the start of each of its turns and falls prone. The trapsmith has advantage on the attack roll if the target wears metal armor. The stunner is a bola made of wire, magnets, and static-electricity capacitors. The kobold trapsmith can recharge it during a long rest.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.desc: The kobold has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the kobold's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.desc: While in sunlight, the kobold has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.desc: mw,rw 4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Sling
actions.desc: rw 4 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. {@h}4 (1d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Weapon Invention
actions.desc:
The kobold uses one of the following options (choose one or roll a d8); the kobold can use each one no more than once per day:

- The kobold hurls a acid (vial). rw 4 to hit, range 5/20 ft., one target. {@h}7 (2d6) acid damage.
- The kobold throws a Alchemist's Fire (flask). rw 4 to hit, range 5/20 ft., one target. {@h}2 (1d4) fire damage at the start of each of the target's turns. The target can end this damage by using its action to make a DC 10 Dexterity check to extinguish the flames.
- The kobold throws a small basket into a 5-foot-square space within 20 feet of it. A Swarm of Centipedes with 11 hit points emerges from the basket and rolls initiative. At the end of each of the swarm's turns, there's a 50 chance that the swarm disperses.
- The kobold throws a clay pot full of green slime at the target, and it breaks open on impact. rw 4 to hit, range 5/20 ft., one target. {@h}5 (1d10) acid damage, and the target is covered in slime until a creature uses its action to scrape or wash the slime off. A target covered in the slime takes 5 (1d10) acid damage at the start of each of its turns.
- The kobold throws a clay pot into a 5-foot-square space within 20 feet of it, and it breaks open on impact. A swarm of rot grubs (in this book) emerges from the shattered pot and remains a hazard in that square.
- The kobold makes a melee attack with a scorpion tied to the end of a 5-foot-long pole. mw 4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}1 piercing damage, and the target must make a DC 9 Constitution saving throw, taking 4 (1d8) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
- The kobold releases a skunk into an unoccupied space within 5 feet of it. The skunk has a walking speed of 20 feet, AC 10, 1 hit point, and no effective attacks. It rolls initiative and, on its turn, uses its action to spray musk at a random creature within 5 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 9 Constitution saving throw, or it retches and is incapacitated for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. A creature that doesn't need to breathe or is immune to poison automatically succeeds on the saving throw. Once the skunk has sprayed its musk, it can't do so again until it finishes a short or long rest.
- The kobold throws a small bag into a 5-foot-square space within 20 feet of it. A Swarm of Wasps with 11 hit points emerges from the bag and rolls initiative. At the end of each of the swarm's turns, there's a 50 chance that the swarm disperses.

traits.name: Sneak Attack
traits.desc: Once per turn, the kobold deals an extra 3 (1d6) damage when it hits a target with a weapon attack and has advantage on the attack roll.

traits.name: Evasion
traits.desc: If the kobold is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, the kobold instead takes no damage on a success and only half damage on a failure.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.desc: While in sunlight, the kobold has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.desc: The kobold has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the kobold's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and that ally isn't incapacitated.

actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4+3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Sling
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4+3) bludgeoning damage.

traits.name: Aerial Withdraw
traits.desc: The kongamato doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

traits.name: Boat Breaker
traits.desc: The kongamato deals double damage to objects and structures made of wood or lighter materials.

traits.name: Carry Off
traits.desc: A kongamato can carry off prey weighing up to 55 pounds, or a single rider of the same weight. A group can carry up to 110 pounds.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The kongamato makes one bite attack and two claw attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (4d6 + 4) piercing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it is grappled (escape DC 14). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the kongamato can't bite another target. When the kongamato moves, the grappled creature moves with it.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) slashing damage.

traits.name: Devil's Sight
traits.desc: Magical darkness doesn't impede the koralk's darkvision.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The koralk has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Steadfast
traits.desc: A koralk can't be frightened while it can see an allied creature within 30 feet of it.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: A koralk makes three stinger attacks and two scythe attacks. It can also make one bite attack against a target it is grappling.

actions.name: Scythe
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d12 + 3) slashing damage, or the koralk can instead grab a Medium or smaller target with its smaller vestigial arms (no damage, escape DC 13).

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one grappled target. Hit: 19 (3d10 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Stinger
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned. While poisoned, the target takes 10 (3d6) poison damage at the start of each of its turns as its entrails liquefy. A creature that succeeds on its saving throw is immune to the koralk's poison for 24 hours. If the creature dies while under the effects of a koralk's poison, its corpse bursts and a newly formed lemure slicked with foul fluid crawls out. The lemure obeys the highest-ranking devil nearby. The poison can be neutralized by lesser restoration, protection from poison, or similar magic. If the lemure is killed, the original creature can be returned to life only by means of a resurrection spell or similar magic.

traits.name: Hidden Soul
traits.desc: A creature holding the egg that contains Koschei's soul can use its action to command the fiend as if the fiend had been targeted by dominate monster and had failed its saving throw. While his soul is in the needle, Koschei can't be permanently slain. If he perishes, his body reforms in his lair within 1d10 days. If the needle is broken, Koschei can be killed like anyone else.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc:
Koschei's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 19, +11 to hit with spell attacks). He can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
At will: detect magic, phantom steed, scorching ray, sending
3/day each: invisibility, magic missile, shield
2/day each: animate objects, cone of cold, hypnotic pattern
1/day each: disintegrate, meteor swarm, shapechange

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If Koschei fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.desc: Koschei's weapon attacks are magical and deal an extra 14 (4d6) necrotic damage (included below).

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Koschei makes two longsword attacks and one life drain attack.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d8 + 6) slashing damage, or 11 (1d10 + 6) slashing damage if used with two hands, plus 14 (4d6) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Life Drain
actions.desc: Melee Spell Attack: +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (4d6 + 6) necrotic damage. The target must succeed on a DC 19 Constitution saving throw or its hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the damage taken, and Koschei regains hit points equal to that amount. The reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its hit point maximum to 0.

legendaryActions.name: Attack
legendaryActions.desc: Koschei makes one longsword attack.

legendaryActions.name: Teleport
legendaryActions.desc: Koschei magically teleports to an unoccupied space he can see within 40 feet.

legendaryActions.name: Drain (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.desc: Koschei makes one life drain attack.

traits.name: Healing
traits.desc: The kot bayun's tales have, at will, the same effect as lesser restoration, and once per week the same effect as greater restoration. The cat designates one listener who benefits from this power. The listener must spend an hour listening without interruption. Kot bayuns are reluctant to grant this healing, so they must be bargained with or compelled by a domination effect.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc:
The kot bayun's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 13). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
3/day each: fog cloud, invisibility (self only)
1/day: blink

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The kot bayun makes one bite attack and one claw attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d10 + 3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Sleep Song
actions.desc: The kot bayun puts others to sleep with an entrancing lullaby. While it sings, it can target one listener within 100 feet. The listener must succeed on a DC 13 Charisma saving throw or fall asleep. It repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. The kot bayun can choose a new target each round it continues the song. A creature that succeeds on its saving throw is immune to that kot bayun's lullaby for 24 hours. The sleep song affects even elves, but they have advantage on the Charisma saving throw.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.desc: The kraken can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Freedom of Movement
traits.desc: The kraken ignores difficult terrain, and magical effects can't reduce its speed or cause it to be restrained. It can spend 5 feet of movement to escape from nonmagical restraints or being grappled.

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.desc: The kraken deals double damage to objects and structures.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The kraken makes three tentacle attacks, each of which it can replace with one use of Fling.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: mw 17 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}23 (3d8 + 10) piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature grappled by the kraken, that creature is swallowed, and the grapple ends. While swallowed, the creature is blinded and restrained, it has Cover against attacks and other effects outside the kraken, and it takes 42 (12d6) acid damage at the start of each of the kraken's turns. If the kraken takes 50 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the kraken must succeed on a DC 25 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which fall prone in a space within 10 feet of the kraken. If the kraken dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse using 15 feet of movement, exiting prone.

actions.name: Tentacle
actions.desc: mw 17 to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. {@h}20 (3d6 + 10) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 18). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained. The kraken has ten tentacles, each of which can grapple one target.

actions.name: Fling
actions.desc: One Large or smaller object held or creature grappled by the kraken is thrown up to 60 feet in a random direction and knocked prone. If a thrown target strikes a solid surface, the target takes 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage for every 10 feet it was thrown. If the target is thrown at another creature, that creature must succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw or take the same damage and be knocked prone.

actions.name: Lightning Storm
actions.desc: The kraken magically creates three bolts of lightning, each of which can strike a target the kraken can see within 120 feet of it. A target must make a DC 23 Dexterity saving throw, taking 22 (4d10) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

legendaryActions.name: Tentacle Attack or Fling
legendaryActions.desc: The kraken makes one tentacle attack or uses its Fling.

legendaryActions.name: Lightning Storm (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.desc: The kraken uses Lightning Storm.

legendaryActions.name: Ink Cloud (Costs 3 Actions)
legendaryActions.desc: While underwater, the kraken expels an ink cloud in a 60-foot radius. The cloud spreads around corners, and that area is Vision and Light to creatures other than the kraken. Each creature other than the kraken that ends its turn there must succeed on a DC 23 Constitution saving throw, taking 16 (3d10) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A strong current disperses the cloud, which otherwise disappears at the end of the kraken's next turn.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.desc: The kuo-toa can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Otherworldly Perception
traits.desc: The kuo-toa can sense the presence of any creature within 30 feet of it that is invisible or on the Ethereal Plane. It can pinpoint such a creature that is moving.

traits.name: Slippery
traits.desc: The kuo-toa has advantage on ability checks and saving throws made to escape a grapple.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.desc: While in sunlight, the kuo-toa has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: mw 3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}3 (1d4 + 1) piercing damage.

actions.name: Spear
actions.desc: mw,rw 3 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}4 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage, or 5 (1d8 + 1) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

actions.name: Net
actions.desc: rw 3 to hit, range 5/15 ft., one Large or smaller creature. {@h}The target is restrained. A creature can use its action to make a DC 10 Strength check to free itself or another creature in a net, ending the effect on a success. Dealing 5 slashing damage to the net (AC 10) frees the target without harming it and destroys the net.

reactions.name: Sticky Shield
reactions.desc: When a creature misses the kuo-toa with a melee weapon attack, the kuo-toa uses its sticky shield to catch the weapon. The attacker must succeed on a DC 11 Strength saving throw, or the weapon becomes stuck to the kuo-toa's shield. If the weapon's wielder can't or won't let go of the weapon, the wielder is grappled while the weapon is stuck. While stuck, the weapon can't be used. A creature can pull the weapon free by taking an action to make a DC 11 Strength check and succeeding.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.desc: The kuo-toa can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Otherworldly Perception
traits.desc: The kuo-toa can sense the presence of any creature within 30 feet of it that is invisible or on the Ethereal Plane. It can pinpoint such a creature that is moving.

traits.name: Slippery
traits.desc: The kuo-toa has advantage on ability checks and saving throws made to escape a grapple.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.desc: While in sunlight, the kuo-toa has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The kuo-toa makes two melee attacks.

actions.name: Scepter
actions.desc: mw 6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 14 (4d6) lightning damage.

actions.name: Unarmed Strike
actions.desc: mw 6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 (1d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.desc: The kuo-toa can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Otherworldly Perception
traits.desc: The kuo-toa can sense the presence of any creature within 30 feet of it that is invisible or on the Ethereal Plane. It can pinpoint such a creature that is moving.

traits.name: Slippery
traits.desc: The kuo-toa has advantage on ability checks and saving throws made to escape a grapple.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.desc: While in sunlight, the kuo-toa has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The kuo-toa makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its pincer staff.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: mw 4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Pincer Staff
actions.desc: mw 4 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it is grappled (escape DC 14). Until this grapple ends, the kuo-toa can't use its pincer staff on another target.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The lamia makes two attacks: one with its claws and one with its dagger or Intoxicating Touch.

actions.name: Claws
