actions.desc: mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 (2d10 + 3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.desc: mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Intoxicating Touch
actions.desc: ms 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}The target is magically cursed for 1 hour. Until the curse ends, the target has disadvantage on Wisdom saving throws and all ability checks.

traits.name: Fear of Fire
traits.desc: If the yeti takes fire damage, it has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks until the end of its next turn.

traits.name: Keen Smell
traits.desc: The yeti has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

traits.name: Snow Camouflage
traits.desc: The yeti has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide in snowy terrain.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The yeti can use its Chilling Gaze and makes two claw attacks.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: mw 11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 (2d6 + 7) slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) cold damage.

actions.name: Chilling Gaze
actions.desc: The yeti targets one creature it can see within 30 feet of it. If the target can see the yeti, the target must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw against this magic or take 21 (6d6) cold damage and then be paralyzed for 1 minute, unless it is immune to cold damage. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If the target's saving throw is successful, or if the effect ends on it, the target is immune to this yeti's gaze for 1 hour.

actions.name: Cold Breath {@recharge}
actions.desc: The yeti exhales a 30-foot cone of frigid air. Each creature in that area must make a DC 18 Constitution saving throw, taking 45 (10d8) cold damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8+2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Burst Wave (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: The rock larva emits a wave in a 10-foot cone. Each creature in the cone must make a DC 12 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 5 (1d10) thunder damage and is stunned for 1 minute. On a success, it takes only half damage and isn't stunned. A stunned creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the condition on a success.

traits.name: Interdimensional Movement
traits.desc: A star larva of Cthulhu can use misty step as a bonus action once per round.

traits.name: Psychic Bulwark
traits.desc: When an attack that deals psychic damage targets the larva, it rebounds toward the attacker. Resolve the attack as if the attacker were the original target, using the larva's ability modifiers and proficiencies instead of the attacker's.

traits.name: Void Traveler
traits.desc: The star larva of Cthulhu needs no air, heat, ambient pressure, food, or water, which allows it to travel safely through interstellar space and any similar void.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The star larva uses Disintegration Gaze if it is available, and it also makes one crushing claws attack and one dimensional step attack.

actions.name: Crushing Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (2d12 + 7) bludgeoning damage plus 13 (3d8) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Disintegration Gaze (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: Ranged Spell Attack: +15 to hit, range 60 ft., one target it can see. Hit: 32 (5d12) necrotic damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution saving throw or dissipate into vapor, as if affected by the gaseous form spell. An affected creature repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns. On a success, the effect ends, but on a failure the creature takes another 32 (5d12) necrotic damage and remains gaseous. A creature reduced to 0 hit points by this necrotic damage is permanently disintegrated and can't return to life except by means of a wish or similar magic that doesn't require a piece of its corpse to function.

actions.name: Dimensional Step
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (2d20 + 7) bludgeoning damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or be teleported elsewhere, as with the dimension door spell. The star larva chooses the destination, which can't be a space already occupied by an object or a creature.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc:
The leshy's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 13). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
At will: animal friendship, pass without trace, speak with animals
1/day each: entangle, plant growth, shillelagh, speak with plants, tasha's hideous laughter

traits.name: Camouflage
traits.desc: The leshy has advantage on Stealth checks while it has at least light obscurement from foliage.

traits.name: Mimicry
traits.desc: The leshy can mimic the cries and voices of any creature it has heard. Doing so requires a Charisma (Deception) check. A listener that succeeds on a Wisdom (Insight) or Intelligence (Nature) check (GM's choice) recognizes the mimicry. The leshy has advantage on the check if it imitates a general type of creature (a crow's caw, a bear's roar) rather than the voice of a specific individual.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The leshy makes two club attacks.

actions.name: Change Size
actions.desc: The leshy appears to change size, growing as tall as an oak tree (Gargantuan) or as small as a blade of grass (Tiny). This is only an illusion, so its statistics don't change.

actions.name: Club
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

traits.name: Devil's Sight
traits.desc: Magical darkness doesn't impede the lemure's darkvision.

traits.name: Hellish Rejuvenation
traits.desc: A lemure that dies in the Nine Hells comes back to life with all its hit points in 1d10 days unless it is killed by a good-aligned creature with a bless spell cast on that creature or its remains are sprinkled with Holy Water (Flask).

actions.name: Fist
actions.desc: mw 3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}2 (1d4) bludgeoning damage.

traits.name: Bone Wrack
traits.desc: When the slow storm hits a living creature with a slam attack or its breath, it absorbs the moisture from the creature's joints, causing stiffness and pain. In addition to this drain of 1d4 Dexterity, if the creature is caught in the slow storm's breath and fails another DC 18 Constitution saving throw, it suffers horrible aches in its bones and joints. Each round it moves while suffering this pain, it takes 1d4 necrotic damage for every 5 feet it travels. The pain of the bone wrack persists until the creature recovers at least 1 point of the lost Dexterity.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc:
The slow storm's innate spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 16). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
At will: lightning bolt
3/day: chain lightning

traits.name: Storm Form
traits.desc: If a creature starts its turn in the slow storm's wind or enters that wind, the creature takes 9 (2d8) force damage. A creature takes this damage only once per round. In addition, ranged projectile attacks against the slow storm have disadvantage because of the fierce winds surrounding it.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 31 (4d12 + 5) bludgeoning damage plus 9 (2d8) piercing damage.

actions.name: Electrical Discharge (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: The slow storm spits its electricity in a 30-foot cone. Targets in the affected area take 54 (12d8) lightning damage, lose 1d4 Dexterity, and suffer the bone ravages. A DC 18 Constitution saving throw halves the Dexterity loss and prevents the bone ravages.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: mw 0 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}1 piercing damage.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: mw 4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The spore servant makes two hook attacks.

actions.name: Hook
actions.desc: mw 6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage.

traits.name: Brave
traits.desc: Liara has advantage on saving throws against being frightened.

traits.name: Flaming Fury
traits.desc: Once per turn, when Liara hits a creature with a melee weapon, she can cause fire to magically erupt from her weapon and deal an extra 10 (3d6) fire damage to the target.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Liara makes three melee attacks.

actions.name: Battleaxe
actions.desc: mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage, or 8 (1d10 + 3) slashing damage when used with two hands.

actions.name: Heavy Crossbow
actions.desc: rw 3 to hit, range 100/400 ft., one target. {@h}6 (1d10 + 1) piercing damage.

liche.name: Lich
languages: Common plus up to five other languages

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If the lich fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Rejuvenation
traits.desc: If it has a phylactery, a destroyed lich gains a new body in 1d10 days, regaining all its hit points and becoming active again. The new body appears within 5 feet of the phylactery.

traits.name: Turn Resistance
traits.desc: The lich has advantage on saving throws against any effect that turns undead.

actions.name: Paralyzing Touch
actions.desc: ms 12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}10 (3d6) cold damage. The target must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or be paralyzed for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

legendaryActions.name: Cantrip
legendaryActions.desc: The lich casts a cantrip.

legendaryActions.name: Paralyzing Touch (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.desc: The lich uses its Paralyzing Touch.

legendaryActions.name: Frightening Gaze (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.desc: The lich fixes its gaze on one creature it can see within 10 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw against this magic or become frightened for 1 minute. The frightened target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a target's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the target is immune to the lich's gaze for the next 24 hours.

legendaryActions.name: Disrupt Life (Costs 3 Actions)
legendaryActions.desc: Each non-undead creature within 20 feet of the lich must make a DC 18 Constitution saving throw against this magic, taking 21 (6d6) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

traits.name: Keen Smell and Hearing
traits.desc: The canine lich has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d12 + 4) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

actions.name: Ethereal Leap
actions.desc: The canine lich can magically shift from the Ethereal Plane to the Material Plane and vice versa as a bonus action.

actions.name: Eviscerate
actions.desc: As a bonus action, the canine lich rips the flesh of any prone creature adjacent to it, dealing 19 (3d12) slashing damage. The target must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be incapacitated for 1d4 rounds. An incapacitated creature repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

actions.name: Howl
actions.desc: The eerie howl of a canine lich closing in on its prey breaks the morale of living creatures that hear it. The howl requires an action. Creatures within 100 feet that hear it must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened for 5 rounds. A creature that succeeds on its saving throw against this effect can't be affected by a canine lich's howl for 24 hours.

traits.name: Charge
traits.desc: If the unicorn moves at least 20 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a horn attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 9 (2d8) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The unicorn has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.desc: The unicorn's weapon attacks are magical.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The unicorn makes two attacks: one with its hooves and one with its horn.

actions.name: Hooves
actions.desc: mw 7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Horn
actions.desc: mw 7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Healing Touch (3/Day)
actions.desc: The unicorn touches another creature with its horn. The target magically regains 11 (2d8 + 2) hit points. In addition, the touch removes all diseases and neutralizes all poisons afflicting the target.

actions.name: Teleport (1/Day)
actions.desc: The unicorn magically teleports itself and up to three willing creatures it can see within 5 feet of it, along with any equipment they are wearing or carrying, to a location the unicorn is familiar with, up to 1 mile away.

legendaryActions.name: Hooves
legendaryActions.desc: The unicorn makes one attack with its hooves.

legendaryActions.name: Shimmering Shield (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.desc: The unicorn creates a shimmering, magical field around itself or another creature it can see within 60 feet of it. The target gains a +2 bonus to AC until the end of the unicorn's next turn.

legendaryActions.name: Heal Self (Costs 3 Actions)
legendaryActions.desc: The unicorn magically regains 11 (2d8 + 2) hit points.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.desc: While the creeper remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary flowering vine.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.desc: The creeper regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn. If the creeper takes fire, necrotic, or radiant damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of its next turn. The creeper dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

actions.name: Touch
actions.desc: mw 3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}13 (3d8) psychic damage. If the target is a humanoid that drops to 0 hit points as a result of this damage, it dies and is implanted with a yellow musk creeper bulb. Unless the bulb is destroyed, the corpse animates as a yellow musk zombie after being dead for 24 hours. The bulb is destroyed if the creature is raised from the dead before it can transform into a yellow musk zombie, or if the corpse is targeted by a remove curse spell or similar magic before it animates.

actions.name: Yellow Musk (3/Day)
actions.desc: The creeper's flowers release a strong musk that targets all humanoids within 30 feet of it. Each target must succeed on a DC 11 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by the creeper for 1 minute. A creature charmed in this way does nothing on its turn except move as close as it can to the creeper. A creature charmed by the creeper can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.desc: While the blight remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a tangle of vines.

actions.name: Constrict
actions.desc: mw 4 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}9 (2d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage, and a Large or smaller target is grappled (escape DC 12). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the blight can't constrict another target.

actions.name: Entangling Plants {@recharge 5}
actions.desc: Grasping roots and vines sprout in a 15-foot radius centered on the blight, withering away after 1 minute. For the duration, that area is difficult terrain for nonplant creatures. In addition, each creature of the blight's choice in that area when the plants appear must succeed on a DC 12 Strength saving throw or become restrained. A creature can use its action to make a DC 12 Strength check, freeing itself or another entangled creature within reach on a success.

traits.name: Aggressive Leap
traits.desc: If the likho moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and hits it with a claw attack on the same turn, that creature must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, the likho can use a bonus action to make two additional claw attacks against it.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc:
The likho's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 16). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
At will: message
3/day each: crown of madness, mirror image, ray of enfeeblement
1/day: bestow curse

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The likho has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The likho makes two claw attacks.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Unnerving Gaze
actions.desc: As a bonus action, the likho turns its gaze on a single creature it can see and temporarily jinxes it. The target has disadvantage on attack rolls, saving throws, and ability checks until the end of its next turn.

limon-des-sarcophages.name: Sarcophagus Slime
limon-des-sarcophages.languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

traits.name: Amorphous
traits.desc: The sarcophagus slime can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The sarcophagus slime uses Frightful Presence and Corrupting Gaze, and it makes two slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage plus 14 (4d6) acid damage.

actions.name: Frightful Presence
actions.desc: Each creature of the sarcophagus slime's choice within 60 feet of it and aware of it must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened for 1 minute. A frightened creature repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. If a target succeeds on its saving throw or the effect ends for it, the target is immune to the slime's Frightful Presence for the next 24 hours.

actions.name: Corrupting Gaze
actions.desc: The sarcophagus slime targets one creature it can see within 30 feet. If the target can see the slime, it must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or take 14 (4d6) necrotic damage and have its hit point maximum reduced by an amount equal to the damage taken. If this effect reduces a creature's hit point maximum to 0, the creature dies and its corpse transforms into a sarcophagus slime within 24 hours. The reduction lasts until the creature finishes a long rest or benefits from a greater restoration spell or similar magic.

traits.name: Amorphous
traits.desc: The shroud can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

traits.name: Shadow Metamorphosis
traits.desc: A shroud instantly transforms into a shadow once it has dealt 12 points of damage. Any damage the shroud has taken is subtracted from the shadow's hit point or ability score total.

traits.name: Shroud Stealth
traits.desc: When the shroud is in darkness or dim light, it can take the Hide action as a bonus action.

traits.name: Sunlight Weakness
traits.desc: While in sunlight, the shroud has disadvantage on attack rolls, ability checks, and saving throws.

actions.name: Strength Drain
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) necrotic damage, and the target's Strength score is reduced by half that amount. The target dies if this reduces its Strength to 0; otherwise, the reduction lasts until the target finishes a short or long rest. If a non-evil humanoid dies from this attack, a shadow rises from its corpse 1d4 hours later.

traits.name: Lindwurm Fever
traits.desc: If a creature is infected with this disease from a lindwurm bite, it gains one level of exhaustion one hour after infection. It must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw after each long rest. On a failure, it gains one level of exhaustion and doesn't regain hit dice from the rest. On a success, it sheds one level of exhaustion and regains hit dice normally from the long rest. If it manages to remove all its levels of exhaustion by succeeding on saving throws, it recovers from the disease.

traits.name: Agile Skater
traits.desc: A lindwurm suffers no penalty from difficult terrain made of ice, and it is immune to the effects of the grease spell.

traits.name: Serpent Belly
traits.desc: If the lindwurm lies belly-down against ice, it senses the approach of a creature through the vibrations it causes, giving it tremorsense.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The lindwurm makes one bite attack, one claw attack, and one constrict attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or contract lindwurm fever.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (3d8 + 4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Constrict
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 14). The target is restrained, and the lindwurm can't constrict another target while this grapple persists.

traits.name: Keen Smell
traits.desc: The lion has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.desc: The lion has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the lion's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

traits.name: Pounce
traits.desc: If the lion moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a claw attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, the lion can make one bite attack against it as a bonus action.

traits.name: Running Leap
traits.desc: With a 10-foot running start, the lion can long jump up to 25 feet.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage.

traits.name: Alien Mentality
traits.desc: The liosalfar's exotic consciousness makes it immune to psychic effects. A creature that tries to read its thoughts is confused for 1 round.

traits.name: Darkness Vulnerability
traits.desc: Magical darkness harms the liosalfar. Each time it starts its turn within magical darkness, it takes 2d10 necrotic damage, or half as much on a successful DC 14 Constitution saving throw. It dislikes natural darkness, but natural darkness causes it no harm.

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.desc: A liosalfar can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc:
The liosalfar's innate spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 15, +7 to hit with spell attacks). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
At will: augury, dancing lights, detect magic, light, silent image, spare the dying
2/day each: alter self, blur, divination, hypnotic pattern, prismatic spray, scorching ray
1/day each: hallucinatory terrain, plane shift, sunbeam

traits.name: Luminous Form
traits.desc: A liosalfar is composed entirely of light. It is incorporeal and subject to no ability damage, nor to polymorph, petrification, or any form-altering attack.

traits.name: Prismatic Glow
traits.desc: A liosalfar emits rainbow light equal to the daylight spell. It can't extinguish this light without dying, but it can at will reduce it to the brightness of a torch. Even when using alter self, it emits a diffuse glow that can be spotted in darkness or dim light.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The liosalfar makes two disrupting touch attacks.

actions.name: Disrupting Touch
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 26 (4d12) radiant damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be stunned for 1 round.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: An elemental locus has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Immortal
traits.desc: An elemental locus doesn't age, and it doesn't die when reduced to 0 hit points. If the elemental locus drops to 0 hit points, it enters a dormant state for 25 weeks before becoming active again with all its hit points recovered. Elementals it spawned keep fighting the enemies that attacked the elemental locus. If no enemies are present, they defend the area where the elemental locus settled.

traits.name: Immense
traits.desc: An elemental locus is larger than most Gargantuan creatures and occupies a space 60 feet on a side. Its movement is unaffected by difficult terrain and by creatures of Huge size or smaller. Other creatures can enter and pass through the elemental locus's space, but they must succeed on a DC 20 Strength (Athletics) check for every 10 feet of movement. On a failure, they fall prone and can move no farther that turn.

traits.name: Spawn Elementals
traits.desc: As a bonus action, an elemental locus can lose 82 hit points and spawn an air, earth, fire, or water elemental to serve it. Elementals spawned this way are subject to their creator's will and aren't fully independent. The kind of elemental an elemental locus can spawn depends on the terrain it embodies. For example, a desert elemental locus can spawn earth, fire, and air elementals, but not water elementals.

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.desc: An elemental locus deals double damage to objects and structures.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The elemental locus makes two slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +15 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 36 (6d8 + 9) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 23 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

traits.name: Alluring Presence
traits.desc: Every humanoid within 30 feet of the lorelei that looks directly at her must succeed on a DC 17 Charisma saving throw or be drawn to her by the most direct route, ignoring danger. This attraction ends when the creature comes within 5 feet of the lorelei. A creature can avoid this effect for a full round by averting its eyes at the start of its turn, but it has disadvantage on attack rolls and other actions directed at the lorelei until the start of its next turn. The lorelei can switch this power off or on as a bonus action. A creature that succeeds on its saving throw against this effect can't be affected by the same lorelei's Alluring Presence for 24 hours.

traits.name: Supernatural Grace
traits.desc: The lorelei adds her Charisma modifier in place of her normal modifier to all her saving throws.

traits.name: Aquatic Spirit
traits.desc: The lorelei is under the effect of freedom of movement whenever she is in contact with a body of water.

traits.name: Spellcasting
traits.desc:
The lorelei is an 8th-level spellcaster. Her spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 17, +9 to hit with spell attacks). She needs no material components to cast her spells. She has the following sorcerer spells prepared:
Cantrips (at will): detect magic, guidance, light, mending, poison spray, prestidigitation
1st level (4 slots): comprehend languages, fog cloud, mage armor, ray of sickness
2nd level (3 slots): hold person, misty step, suggestion
3rd level (3 slots): hypnotic pattern, gaseous form, water walk
4th level (2 slots): dominate beast, ice storm

actions.name: Dagger
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d4 + 5) piercing damage.

actions.name: Charm
actions.desc: The lorelei targets one humanoid she can see within 30 feet. If the target can see or hear the lorelei, it must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw against this magic or be charmed by her. The charmed target regards the lorelei as its one true love, to be heeded and protected. It isn't under the lorelei's control, but it interprets her wishes and actions in the most favorable way. Each time the target takes damage from the lorelei or her companions, directly or indirectly, it repeats the saving throw, ending the effect on a success. Otherwise, the effect lasts 24 hours, until the lorelei is killed, until she is on a different plane of existence from the target, or until she ends the effect as a bonus action.

actions.name: Stunning Gaze
actions.desc: With a look, the lorelei mentally disrupts one creature within 30 feet. The target must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or be stunned for 2 rounds. A target that succeeds on its saving throw against this effect can't be affected by the same lorelei's Stunning Gaze for 24 hours.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.desc: The wolf has advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the wolf's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the incapacitated condition.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: mw 4 to hit; reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 (2d4 + 2) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 11 Strength saving throw or have the prone condition.

traits.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
traits.desc: The wolf has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.desc: The wolf has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the wolf's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

traits.name: Snow Camouflage
traits.desc: The wolf has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide in snowy terrain.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: mw 6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

actions.name: Cold Breath {@recharge 5}
actions.desc: The wolf exhales a blast of freezing wind in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw, taking 18 (4d8) cold damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

loup-garou.name: Loup Garou
loup-garou.speed: walk {'number': 30, 'condition': '(40 ft. in hybrid form, 50 ft. in dire wolf form)'}

traits.name: Blood Frenzy
traits.desc: The loup garou has advantage on attack rolls against a creature that doesn't have all its hit points.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (2/Day)
traits.desc: When the loup garou fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.desc: The loup garou regains 10 hit points at the start of each of its turns. If the loup garou takes damage from a silver weapon, this trait doesn't function at the start of the loup garou's next turn. The loup garou dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The loup garou makes two attacks: two with its Longsword (humanoid form) or one with its Bite and one with its Claws (dire wolf or hybrid form).

actions.name: Bite (Dire Wolf or Hybrid Form Only)
actions.desc: mw 9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage plus 14 (4d6) necrotic damage. If the target is a Humanoid, it must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or be cursed with loup garou Player Characters as Lycanthropes.

actions.name: Claws (Dire Wolf or Hybrid Form Only)
actions.desc: mw 9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 17 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

actions.name: Longsword (Humanoid Form Only)
actions.desc: mw 9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 (2d8 + 4) slashing damage, or 15 (2d10 + 4) slashing damage if used with two hands.

legendaryActions.name: Swipe
legendaryActions.desc: The loup garou makes one Claws attack (dire wolf or hybrid form only) or one Longsword attack (humanoid form only).

legendaryActions.name: Mauling Pounce (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.desc: The loup garou moves up to its speed without provoking opportunity attacks, and it can make one Claws attack (dire wolf or hybrid form only) or one Longsword attack (humanoid form only) against each creature it moves past.

legendaryActions.name: Bite (Costs 3 Actions)
legendaryActions.desc: The loup garou changes into hybrid or dire wolf form and then makes one Bite attack.

traits.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
traits.desc: The wolf has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.desc: The wolf has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the wolf's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

traits.name: Crushing Charge
traits.desc: If the loxoda moves at least 20 feet straight toward a Large or larger creature and hits it with a tread attack, it has advantage on that attack. If that attack hits, the target must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The loxoda makes two attacks, no more than one of which can be a warhammer or javelin attack.

actions.name: Warhammer
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 25 (6d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Tread
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (3d10 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Javelin
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) piercing damage.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc:
The lynx's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma. It can cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
3/day: gaseous form

traits.name: Misty Constitution
traits.desc: The mist lynx spends its time shifting between gaseous and solid form. Its unique constitution makes it immune to all attacks and spells involving fog or gas, including its own. The mist lynx can see perfectly through mist, fog, and spells such as fog cloud that create reduced or no visibility.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The mist lynx makes one bite attack and two claw attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (3d8 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Poison Breath (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: The mist lynx breathes poisonous fog in a 40-foot radius, reducing visibility to nil in a spherical area around it. Any breathing creature that ends its turn in the fog must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1d4 + 1 rounds.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.desc: mw,rw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

traits.name: Death Burst
traits.desc: When the magmin dies, it explodes in a burst of fire and magma. Each creature within 10 feet of it must make a DC 11 Dexterity saving throw, taking 7 (2d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Flammable objects that aren't being worn or carried in that area are ignited.

traits.name: Ignited Illumination
traits.desc: As a bonus action, the magmin can set itself ablaze or extinguish its flames. While ablaze, the magmin sheds bright light in a 10-foot radius and dim light for an additional 10 feet.

actions.name: Touch
actions.desc: mw 4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 (2d6) fire damage. If the target is a creature or a flammable object, it ignites. Until a creature takes an action to douse the fire, the target takes 3 (1d6) fire damage at the end of each of its turns.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.desc: The mahoru can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Keen Sight and Smell
traits.desc: The mahoru has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight or smell.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.desc: The mahoru has advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the mahoru's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

traits.name: Blood Frenzy
traits.desc: The mahoru has advantage on melee attack rolls against any creature that doesn't have all its hit points.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (3d10 + 4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Roar
actions.desc: When a mahoru roars, all creatures that can hear it within 30 feet must make a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw. Those that fail are frightened until the end of the mahoru's next turn. Those that fail by 5 or more are also paralyzed for the same duration. Those that succeed are immune to the roar of all mahorus for 24 hours.

actions.name: Vorpal Bite
actions.desc:
A mahoru's sawtooth jaws are built for dismemberment. When the mahoru scores a critical hit, the target must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or lose a limb. Roll on the following table:
d12 | Result
1-2 | right hand
3-4 | left hand
5-6 | right foot
7-8 | left foot
9 | right forearm
10 | left forearm
11 | right shin
12 | left shin

traits.name: Torrid Radiance
traits.desc: A malakbel generates an aura of intense light and heat in a 30-foot radius. A creature that starts its turn in the aura or enters it for the first time on a turn takes 11 (2d10) radiant damage. The aura's area is brightly lit, and it sheds dim light for an additional 30 feet. The aura dispels magical darkness of 3rd level or lower where their areas of effect overlap.

traits.name: Distortion
traits.desc: Ranged attacks made against a malakbel have disadvantage.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: A malakbel has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: A malakbel makes two scorching burst attacks.

actions.name: Scorching Burst
actions.desc: Ranged Spell Attack: +9 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (3d8 + 5) fire damage.

actions.name: Blazing Torch (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: The malakbel intensifies its torrid radiance to make it devastating. All creatures in the area of the malakbel's aura take 31 (7d8) radiant damage and gain one level of exhaustion. A creature that succeeds on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw takes half that amount of damage and doesn't gain the level of exhaustion.

actions.name: Teleport
actions.desc: A malakbel can magically teleport to an unoccupied space within 100 feet.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.desc: The thug has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the thug's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The thug makes two melee attacks.

actions.name: Mace
actions.desc: mw 4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Heavy Crossbow
actions.desc: rw 2 to hit, range 100/400 ft., one target. {@h}5 (1d10) piercing damage.

mallqui.name: Mallqui
mallqui.languages: the languages it knew in life

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.desc: The mallqui regains 10 hit points at the start of each of its turns. If the mallqui takes damage from its reaction to water, its regeneration doesn't function at the start of its next turn. The mallqui dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc:
The mallqui's innate spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 15, +7 to hit with spell attacks). It can cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
At will: druidcraft, produce flame
4/day each: create or destroy water, entangle
2/day: locate animals or plants
1/day each: dispel magic, plant growth, wind wall

traits.name: Reaction to Water
traits.desc:
The mallqui's flesh putrefies and dissolves rapidly when soaked with water as follows:
Doused with a waterskin or the like: 1d10 damage
Attacked by a creature made of water: normal damage plus 1d10 damage
Rain: 2d10 damage per round (DC 11 Dexterity saving throw for half)
Immersion in water: 4d10 damage per round (DC 13 Dexterity saving throw for half)
You can substitute the save DC of a spell used to summon or control the water that damages the mallqui for the listed values.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The mallqui can use its Xeric Aura and make two withering touch attacks.

actions.name: Withering Touch
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (5d6 + 3) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Xeric Aura
actions.desc: Each creature within 20 feet of the mallqui must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or take 11 (2d10) necrotic damage and gain one level of exhaustion. A creature that succeeds on its saving throw is immune to that mallqui's Xeric Aura for 24 hours.

actions.name: Xeric Burst
actions.desc: Ranged Spell Attack: +7 to hit, range 30/90 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (3d6 + 3) necrotic damage.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc:
The malphas's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 13). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
At will: magic missile
1/day: haste

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.desc: A malphas has disadvantage on attack rolls and on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight while in sunlight.

traits.name: Night Terror (1/Round)
traits.desc: Immediately after hitting with a melee attack, the malphas can use a bonus action to cast magic missile on the same target through its blade.

traits.name: Fencing Training
traits.desc: The malphas trains in combat from an early age. It is proficient with all martial melee and ranged weapons.

traits.name: Call of Shadows
traits.desc: A malphas can cast magic missile as a reaction when it is hit by a ranged weapon attack.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: A malphas makes three longsword attacks.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage.

traits.name: Devil's Sight
traits.desc: Magical darkness doesn't impede Mammon's darkvision.

traits.name: Fiendish Regeneration
traits.desc: Mammon regains 20 hit points at the start of his turn. If he takes radiant damage this trait doesn't function at the start of his next turn. Mammon only dies if he starts his turn with 0 hit points and is unable to regenerate.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If Mammon fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: Mammon has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Mammon uses Fearful Gaze, then makes four attacks using Tail Swipe, Constrict, or a combination of the two.

actions.name: Tail Swipe
actions.desc: mw 17 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}31 (4d10 + 9) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the grappled condition (escape DC 21). While grappled, the creature also has the restrained condition, and Mammon can't make Tail Swipe attacks.

actions.name: Fearful Gaze
actions.desc: Mammon focuses his gaze in a 90-foot cone in front of him. Each creature of his choice within the cone must make a DC 23 Wisdom saving throw, taking 19 (3d12) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Creatures that fail the save have the frightened condition until the end of their next turn.

actions.name: Constrict
actions.desc: Mammon tightens his grip around a creature he has grappled. The target takes 35 (4d12 + 9) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Golden Gaze {@recharge}
actions.desc: Mammon attempts to turn one creature he can see within 60 feet of him into solid gold. The target must make a DC 23 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target's flesh begins to harden, and it has the restrained condition. A restrained creature must repeat the saving throw at the end of each turn. If it successfully saves three times, the effect ends. If it fails three times, it turns to gold and now has the petrified condition. Successes and failures don't need to be consecutive.

reactions.name: Pain Tax
reactions.desc: As a reaction to taking damage, Mammon causes the attacker's valuables to glow red hot. This deals 3 (1d6) fire damage to the attacker for every 100 gold (or equivalent in gems, jewelry, and other coinage) that it currently carries.

legendaryActions.name: Change Form
legendaryActions.desc: Mammon changes his form into that of a pit fiend, maintaining his statistics but losing his actions. He gains the actions and mobility of a pit fiend, including its weapon, and maintains his legendary actions and lair actions. Mammon's serpentine abilities can still recharge while he is in pit fiend form. If Mammon is already a pit fiend, this action changes him back into his serpentine form.

legendaryActions.name: Golden Touch (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.desc: Mammon recharges Golden Gaze.

legendaryActions.name: Call Underling (Costs 3 Actions)
legendaryActions.desc: Mammon summons an allied horned devil in an unoccupied space that he can see.

traits.name: Trampling Charge
traits.desc: If the mammoth moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a gore attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 18 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, the mammoth can make one stomp attack against it as a bonus action.

actions.name: Gore
actions.desc: mw 10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}25 (4d8 + 7) piercing damage.

actions.name: Stomp
actions.desc: mw 10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one prone creature. {@h}29 (4d10 + 7) bludgeoning damage.

mamura.name: Mamura
mamura.languages: Common, Elvish, Goblin, Sylvan, Void Speech

traits.name: All-Around Vision
traits.desc: An attacker never has advantage on attacks against the mamura and deals it no extra damage for having allies nearby.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The mamura has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Friend of Darkness
traits.desc: While in darkness or dim light, the mamura has advantage on Stealth checks. It can attempt to hide as a bonus action at the end of its turn if it is in darkness or dim light.

traits.name: Distraction
traits.desc: Because of the mamura's strange, unsettling aura, a spellcaster within 20 feet must succeed on a DC 14 spellcasting ability check before casting a spell. On a failure, the spellcaster loses its action but not the spell slot. It must also make a DC 14 spellcasting ability check to maintain concentration if it spends part of its turn in the aura.

traits.name: Aerial Withdraw
traits.desc: The mamura doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The mamura makes three pincer attacks and one tail stinger attack.

actions.name: Pincers
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage. The target must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 round. The poison's duration stacks if the target fails multiple saves.

actions.name: Tail Stinger
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage. The target must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or take 1d6 poison damage. If it is also poisoned by the mamura's pincers, it takes an additional 1d6 poison damage at the start of each of its turns while poisoned.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: mw 2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 (2d4) slashing damage.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc:
A fate eater's innate spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 15). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
1/day each: blink, hallucinatory terrain

traits.name: Divinatory Flesh
traits.desc: An individual who feeds on a fate eater's flesh must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw. On a success, it gains a divination spell. On a failure, it vomits blood and also fails the next saving throw it makes during combat.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 26 (5d8 + 4) slashing damage plus 11 (2d10) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Spectral Bite
actions.desc:
When a fate eater scores a critical hit against a target, it doesn't merely wound the creature; it also damages the strands of its fate, changing its victim's past or future. The target must roll 1d6 on the table below for each critical hit it failed to negate with a DC 15 Charisma saving throw:
1 | See the Alternatives: Suffers the effects of the confusion spell for 1d4 rounds
2 | Detached from the Loom: The character's speed becomes random for 4 rounds. At the start of each of its turns, determine its speed with a dice roll: 3d20 x 1 ft.
3 | Altered Memories: Permanently and randomly loses proficiency in one skill it is proficient in, and randomly gains proficiency in another skill it isn't proficient in
4 | Not So Fast: Loses the use of one of its class features, determined randomly
5 | Lost Potential: Loses 1 point in an ability determined randomly
6 | A Sidelined Path: The character's current hit point total becomes its hit point maximum
Effects 3 through 6 are permanent until the character succeeds on a Charisma saving throw. It repeats the saving throw after each long rest, but the DC increases by 1 after each attempt as the character settles ever more deeply into its new destiny. Otherwise, these new fates can be undone only by a wish spell or comparable magic.

mangepoussiere-yakat-shi.name: Dust Eater (Yakat-shi)
mangepoussiere-yakat-shi.languages: understands Abyssal, Common, Infernal, and Void Speech but can't speak, telepathy 100 ft.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc:
A dust eater's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 15, +7 to hit with spell attacks). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
3/day each: freedom of movement, inflict wounds, true strike
1/day each: cure wounds (3rd level), magic weapon (6th level), misty step

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.desc: The dust eater regains 5 hit points at the start of each of its turns. If it takes fire damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of its next turn. The dust eater dies only if it starts its turn at 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

traits.name: Insatiable Hunger
traits.desc:
A dust eater can devour any substance with its jawblade, whatever its composition, and it is never sated. It can even feed on dust or dirt (hence the name various fiends gave the members of this race). If a dust eater's jawblade is stolen, destroyed, or lost, it slowly dies of starvation.
Weapon Bond. A dust eater's jawblade is part of it. It can strike any creature as if the weapon were magically enchanted and made of silver, iron, or any other substance that overcomes that creature's immunities or resistances. A dust eater always knows where its jawblade is, as if using the locate creature spell.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The dust eater makes two jawblade attacks, or it makes one jawblade attack and casts inflict wounds.

actions.name: Jawblade
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, one target. Hit: 19 (4d6 + 5) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or gain one level of exhaustion.

traits.name: Shapechanger
traits.desc: On its turn, a dream eater can polymorph into a Small or Medium humanoid it has seen, or back into its true form. Apart from its size, its statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc:
A dream eater's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 16). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
At will: command
3/day: suggestion

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The dream eater makes one bite attack and one claw attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d8 + 2) piercing damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 12).

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 24 (4d10 + 2) slashing damage.

actions.name: Dream Eater's Caress
actions.desc: A creature still grappled by the dream eater at the end of the dream eater's turn is restrained until the end of its next turn. It also takes 5 (1d4 + 3) psychic damage, and the dream eater gains that many temporary hit points.

actions.name: Lotus Scent (Recharge 6)
actions.desc: A dream eater secretes an oily chemical most creatures find intoxicating. All living creatures within 30 feet of a dream eater must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw against poison or be poisoned for 2d4 rounds. While poisoned, a creature is stunned. A creature that succeeds on its saving throw is immune to that dream eater's lotus scent for 24 hours.

actions.name: Waking Dreams (1/Day)
actions.desc: Each creature within 20 feet of a dream eater must make a DC 16 Charisma saving throw. On a failure, a creature enters a waking-dream state and is confused (as if affected by the confusion spell) for 6 rounds. If a creature can act normally during a turn (rolling a 9 or 10 on the confusion effect), it can repeat the saving throw at the end of that turn, ending the effect early on a success.

traits.name: Echolocation
traits.desc: The darkmantle can't use its blindsight while deafened.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.desc: While the darkmantle remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a cave formation such as a stalactite or stalagmite.

actions.name: Crush
actions.desc:
mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage, and the darkmantle attaches to the target. If the target is Medium or smaller and the darkmantle has advantage on the attack roll, it attaches by engulfing the target's head, and the target is also blinded and unable to breathe while the darkmantle is attached in this way.

While attached to the target, the darkmantle can attack no other creature except the target but has advantage on its attack rolls. The darkmantle's speed also becomes 0, it can't benefit from any bonus to its speed, and it moves with the target.

A creature can detach the darkmantle by making a successful DC 13 Strength check as an action. On its turn, the darkmantle can detach itself from the target by using 5 feet of movement.

actions.name: Darkness Aura (1/Day)
actions.desc: A 15-foot radius of magical darkness extends out from the darkmantle, moves with it, and spreads around corners. The darkness lasts as long as the darkmantle maintains concentration, up to 10 minutes (as if concentration on a spell). Darkvision can't penetrate this darkness, and no natural light can illuminate it. If any of the darkness overlaps with an area of light created by a spell of 2nd level or lower, the spell creating the light is dispelled.

manteau-vide.name: Void Cloak
manteau-vide.languages: understands Elvish and Umbral but can't speak

traits.name: Diligent Sentinel
traits.desc: Void cloaks were created to stand guard against intruders. They have advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks.

traits.name: Shadow Assemblage
traits.desc: Void cloaks are carefully tailored from the substance of shadows. If they take a critical hit, they explode and then dissipate into the shadows.

traits.name: Enveloping Embrace
traits.desc: A void cloak can share the same space with a Medium or smaller creature. The void cloak has advantage on attack rolls against any creature whose space it shares.

actions.name: Slashing Cloak
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Shadow Strike
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Shadow Net
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: Large or smaller creatures are restrained. To escape, the restrained creature or an ally in an adjacent space must take an action and succeed on a DC 14 Strength check. The shadow net has 15 hit points and AC 12.

traits.name: Damage Transfer
traits.desc: While attached to a creature, the cloaker takes only half the damage dealt to it (rounded down), and that creature takes the other half.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.desc: While the cloaker remains motionless without its underside exposed, it is indistinguishable from a dark leather cloak.

traits.name: Light Sensitivity
traits.desc: While in bright light, the cloaker has disadvantage on attack rolls and Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The cloaker makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its tail.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: mw 6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage, and if the target is Large or smaller, the cloaker attaches to it. If the cloaker has advantage against the target, the cloaker attaches to the target's head, and the target is blinded and unable to breathe while the cloaker is attached. While attached, the cloaker can make this attack only against the target and has advantage on the attack roll. The cloaker can detach itself by spending 5 feet of its movement. A creature, including the target, can take its action to detach the cloaker by succeeding on a DC 16 Strength check.

actions.name: Tail
actions.desc: mw 6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. {@h}7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Moan
actions.desc: Each creature within 60 feet of the cloaker that can hear its moan and that isn't an aberration must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened until the end of the cloaker's next turn. If a creature's saving throw is successful, the creature is immune to the cloaker's moan for the next 24 hours.

actions.name: Phantasms (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
actions.desc:
The cloaker magically creates three illusory duplicates of itself if it isn't in bright light. The duplicates move with it and mimic its actions, shifting position so as to make it impossible to track which cloaker is the real one. If the cloaker is ever in an area of bright light, the duplicates disappear.

Whenever any creature targets the cloaker with an attack or a harmful spell while a duplicate remains, that creature rolls randomly to determine whether it targets the cloaker or one of the duplicates. A creature is unaffected by this magical effect if it can't see or if it relies on senses other than sight.

A duplicate has the cloaker's AC and uses its saving throws. If an attack hits a duplicate, or if a duplicate fails a saving throw against an effect that deals damage, the duplicate disappears.

traits.name: Tail Spike Regrowth
traits.desc: The manticore has twenty-four tail spikes. Used spikes regrow when the manticore finishes a long rest.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The manticore makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws or three with its tail spikes.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Tail Spike
actions.desc: rw 5 to hit, range 100/200 ft., one target. {@h}7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.desc: While in sunlight, a forest marauder has disadvantage on attack rolls and on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The forest marauder makes two boar spear attacks.

actions.name: Boar Spear
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) piercing damage, and the forest marauder can push the target 10 feet away if it fails a DC 16 Strength saving throw.

actions.name: Rock
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (3d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

traits.name: Closed-Eyes Curse
traits.desc: If the sandman scores a critical hit or a surprise attack against an opponent, its claws trace a rune on its victim's eyeballs, sealing its eyelids shut and leaving it blind. This effect can be ended with greater restoration, remove curse, or similar magic.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc:
The sandman's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 15). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
At will: darkness, minor illusion, plane shift (night only), phantom steed, prestidigitation, sleep (11d8)
3/day each: hypnotic pattern, major image
1/day each: dream, phantasmal killer (5d10)

traits.name: Made of Dreams
traits.desc: Because the sandman is made of dreams and imagination, it takes only half damage from critical hits and sneak attacks. The total damage of the attack is halved, not just the extra damage.

traits.name: Surprise Attack
traits.desc: If the sandman hits a creature with an attack during the first round of combat and the target is surprised, that attack deals an extra 14 (4d6) damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The sandman makes two claw attacks.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage.

traits.name: Charged Body
traits.desc: If a creature hits the spire walker with a melee attack using a metal weapon, that creature takes 5 (1d10) lightning damage.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc:
The spire walker's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 12, +4 to hit with spell attacks). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
At will: spark (as the produce flame cantrip, but it deals lightning damage)
3/day each: dancing lights, feather fall, invisibility
1/day each: faerie fire, thunderwave

traits.name: Arrow Step
traits.desc: The spire walker can spend 10 feet of movement to magically shift from its position to the tip of a steeple, mast, or other spire-topped feature it can see within 30 feet. The spire walker has advantage on Dexterity (Acrobatics) checks and Dexterity saving throws while it stands on a steeple or a similar sharp, steep structure.

actions.name: Lightning Dart
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 1 piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) lightning damage. If the attack misses, the target still takes 4 (1d8) lightning damage. Whether or not the attack hits the intended target, all other creatures within 10 feet of it take 9 (2d8) lightning damage, or half as much on a successful DC 14 Dexterity saving throw.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.desc: The marid can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Elemental Demise
traits.desc: If the marid dies, its body disintegrates into a burst of water and foam, leaving behind only equipment the marid was wearing or carrying.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The marid makes two trident attacks.

actions.name: Trident
actions.desc: mw,rw 10 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}13 (2d6 + 6) piercing damage, or 15 (2d8 + 6) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

actions.name: Water Jet
actions.desc: The marid magically shoots water in a 60-foot line that is 5 feet wide. Each creature in that line must make a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, a target takes 21 (6d6) bludgeoning damage and, if it is Huge or smaller, is pushed up to 20 feet away from the marid and knocked prone. On a success, a target takes half the bludgeoning damage, but is neither pushed nor knocked prone.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The marilith has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.desc: The marilith's weapon attacks are magical.

traits.name: Reactive
traits.desc: The marilith can take one reaction on every turn in combat.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The marilith can make seven attacks: six with its longswords and one with its tail.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.desc: mw 9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 (2d8 + 4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Tail
actions.desc: mw 9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. {@h}15 (2d10 + 4) bludgeoning damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, it is grappled (escape DC 19). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, the marilith can automatically hit the target with its tail, and the marilith can't make tail attacks against other targets.

actions.name: Teleport
actions.desc: The marilith magically teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

reactions.name: Parry
reactions.desc: The marilith adds 5 to its AC against one melee attack that would hit it. To do so, the marilith must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.desc: The vine puppet regains 5 hit points at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 hit point and is in the jungle.

traits.name: Root Spirit
traits.desc: In the native forest or jungle of a vine lord, the vine puppet has blindsight out to 60 feet, succeeds on all Wisdom (Perception) checks, and can't be surprised.

traits.name: Green Walker
traits.desc: The vine puppet ignores movement restrictions and damage caused by natural undergrowth.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The vine puppet has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Javelin
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage, or 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

actions.name: Thorn Throw
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) piercing damage, and the thorn explodes in a 10-foot-radius sphere centered on the target. Each creature in the affected area other than the original target takes 4 (1d8) piercing damage, or half as much on a successful DC 13 Dexterity saving throw.

traits.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
traits.desc: The mastiff has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: mw 3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 11 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

traits.name: Confusing Gaze
traits.desc:
When a creature starts its turn within 30 feet of the umber hulk and is able to see the umber hulk's eyes, the umber hulk can magically force it to make a DC 15 Charisma saving throw, unless the umber hulk is incapacitated.

On a failed saving throw, the creature can't take reactions until the start of its next turn and rolls a d8 to determine what it does during that turn. On a 1 to 4, the creature does nothing. On a 5 or 6, the creature takes no action but uses all its movement to move in a random direction. On a 7 or 8, the creature makes one melee attack against a random creature, or it does nothing if no creature is within reach.

Unless surprised, a creature can avert its eyes to avoid the saving throw at the start of its turn. If the creature does so, it can't see the umber hulk until the start of its next turn, when it can avert its eyes again. If the creature looks at the umber hulk in the meantime, it must immediately make the save.

traits.name: Tunneler
traits.desc: The umber hulk can burrow through solid rock at half its burrowing speed and leaves a 5 foot-wide, 8-foot-high tunnel in its wake.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The umber hulk makes three attacks: two with its claws and one with its mandibles.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: mw 8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 (1d8 + 5) slashing damage.

actions.name: Mandibles
actions.desc: mw 8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 (2d8 + 5) slashing damage.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc:
The mavka's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 16, +8 to hit with spell attacks). She can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
Constant: protection from evil and good
At will: create or destroy water, dancing lights, ray of frost, resistance, witch bolt
3/day each: darkness, hold person, inflict wounds, invisibility, silence
1/day each: animate dead, bestow curse, blindness/deafness, contagion, dispel magic, vampiric touch

traits.name: Nightmare Mount
traits.desc: A mavka is bound to a nightmare at its creation. Ninety-five percent of the time, it is encountered with its mount.

traits.name: Sunlight Hypersensitivity
traits.desc: The mavka takes 20 radiant damage when it starts its turn in sunlight. While in sunlight, it has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The mavka makes two slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 23 (4d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage plus 11 (2d10) necrotic damage.

traits.name: Toxic Skin
traits.desc: A creature that touches a mbielu or hits it with a melee attack is exposed to the poison coating its skin. That creature must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute. While poisoned this way, it has disadvantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws.

traits.name: Roll Over
traits.desc: If a Large creature grapples a mbielu, the mbielu knocks it over and rolls on top of it, crushing it. The mbielu immediately escapes the grapple, and the creature that grappled it takes 20 (3d10 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Tail
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (3d10 + 4) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

traits.name: Extra Legs
traits.desc: A clockwork abomination has four legs that give it a climb speed equal to half its normal speed and allow it to move normally through difficult terrain.

traits.name: Reach Pistons
traits.desc: The pistons that power a clockwork abomination also give it a surprisingly long reach.

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.desc: A clockwork abomination is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

traits.name: Infernal Power Source
traits.desc: When a clockwork abomination drops to 0 hit points, its infernal battery explodes. Creatures within 10 feet of the abomination take 14 (4d6) fire damage, or half as much on a successful DC 14 Dexterity saving throw.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: A clockwork abomination makes one bite attack and one slam attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) piercing damage.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Breath Weapon (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: The clockwork abomination's infernal power source allows it to spew fire in a 20-foot cone. Creatures caught in the cone take 22 (4d10) fire damage, or half as much on a successful DC 14 Dexterity saving throw.

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.desc: A clockwork weaver spider is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: A clockwork weaver spider has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: A weaver spider makes two ravel-blade attacks or two poisoned needle shuttle attacks.

actions.name: Ravel Blade
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage, with a chance of deconstruction.

actions.name: Poisoned Needle Shuttle
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 30 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be paralyzed. The target repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

actions.name: Deconstruction
actions.desc: A clockwork weaver spider's speed, combined with its razor-sharp blade, lets it shred cloth, leather, and paper in moments. Whenever the spider hits a creature with a ravel-blade attack and the attack roll exceeds the target's Armor Class by 5 or more, the target must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or one of its possessions becomes unusable or damaged until repaired (GM's choice).

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.desc: A clockwork hunter is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: A clockwork hunter has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Net Launcher
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 5/15 ft., one Large or smaller target. Hit: The target is restrained. A mechanism in the clockwork hunter's chest lets it fire a net connected to its torso by a 20-foot cable. A creature can free itself (or another creature) by using an action to make a DC 10 Strength check or by dealing 5 slashing damage to the net. The hunter can fire up to four nets before it must reload the launcher.

actions.name: Explosive Reactor
actions.desc: The mechanism that powers the hunter explodes when the construct is destroyed, spraying jets of scalding steam and shrapnel. All creatures within 5 feet of the construct take 10 (3d6) fire damage, or half as much on a successful DC 13 Dexterity saving throw.

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.desc: A clockwork hound is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: A clockwork hound has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Diligent Trackers
traits.desc: Clockwork hounds are tasked with guarding places or tracking prey. They have advantage on all Wisdom (Perception) and Wisdom (Survival) checks made while tracking.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) piercing damage.

actions.name: Knockdown Tongue
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d8 + 5) slashing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

actions.name: Explosive Reactor
actions.desc: The mechanism that powers the hound explodes when the construct is destroyed. All creatures within 5 feet of the hound take 7 (2d6) fire damage, or half as much on a successful DC 12 Dexterity saving throw.

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.desc: A clockwork gendarme is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: A clockwork gendarme has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Halberd
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d10 + 2) slashing damage.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Net Launcher
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, range 5/15 ft., one Large or smaller target. Hit: The target is restrained. A mechanism in the clockwork gendarme's chest lets it fire a net connected to the gendarme's torso by a 20-foot cable. A creature can free itself (or another creature) by using an action to make a DC 10 Strength check or by dealing 5 slashing damage to the net (AC 10). The gendarme can fire up to four nets before it must reload the launcher.

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.desc: A clockwork myrmidon is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: A clockwork myrmidon has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: A clockwork myrmidon makes two attacks: two spike attacks, two slam attacks, or one of each.

actions.name: War Spike
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) piercing damage.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (1d12 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Greek Fire Spray (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: A clockwork myrmidon can spray a line of greek fire 20 feet long and 5 feet wide. Each creature in the line takes 26 (4d12) fire damage, or half as much on a successful DC 15 Dexterity saving throw. The myrmidon's internal reservoir lets it use this attack four times before running dry.

actions.name: Grease Spray (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: As a bonus action, a clockwork myrmidon can spray a jet of alchemical grease from its chest with a range of 30 feet. The grease covers a 10-foot square, which is then treated as difficult terrain. Each creature in the affected area must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or fall prone. A creature that enters the area or ends its turn there must also succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or fall prone. The myrmidon's internal reservoir lets it use this attack four times before running dry.

actions.name: Greek Fire Bomb
actions.desc: A clockwork myrmidon's greek fire reservoir explodes when the construct is destroyed, spattering nearby creatures with burning fuel. Each creature within 5 feet of the myrmidon takes 19 (3d12) fire damage, or half as much on a successful DC 15 Dexterity saving throw. This explosion doesn't occur if the clockwork myrmidon has already emptied its reservoir by using its Greek Fire Spray four times.

mecanique-scarabee.name: Clockwork Beetle
mecanique-scarabee.languages: understands Common, telepathy 100 ft. (with its creator only)

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.desc: A clockwork beetle is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: A clockwork beetle has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Bite
