legendaryActions.name: Eye Ray
legendaryActions.desc: The beholder uses one random eye ray.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The tyrannosaurus makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its tail. It can't make both attacks against the same target.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: mw 10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}33 (4d12 + 7) piercing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it is grappled (escape DC 17). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the tyrannosaurus can't bite another target.

actions.name: Tail
actions.desc: mw 10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}20 (3d8 + 7) bludgeoning damage.

traits.name: Hold Breath
traits.desc: An ukavac can hold its breath for 20 minutes.

traits.name: Hopping
traits.desc: An ukavac can move its enormous bulk in remarkably quick hops that can carry it up to 20 feet at a time, letting it leap over obstacles or enemies. It can also use this hop as a disengage action.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: An ukavac makes four claw attacks, or two claw attacks and one bite attack, or two claw attacks and one gore attack, or one bite attack and one gore attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (3d10 + 5) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (1d12 + 5) slashing damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 15). An ukavac can grapple up to two Medium enemies.

actions.name: Gore
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (3d10 + 5) piercing damage.

actions.name: Explosive Croak (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: An ukavac can emit a noise like a powerful thunderclap that deafens and injures nearby creatures. Creatures within 15 feet that fail a DC 17 Constitution saving throw take 36 (8d8) thunder damage and are permanently deafened. Those that succeed take only half damage and aren't deafened. The deafness can be cured with lesser restoration.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The ultroloth has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.desc: The ultroloth's weapon attacks are magical.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The ultroloth can use its Hypnotic Gaze and makes three melee attacks.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.desc: mw 8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage, or 8 (1d10 + 3) slashing damage if used with two hands.

actions.name: Hypnotic Gaze
actions.desc: The ultroloth's eyes sparkle with opalescent light as it targets one creature it can see within 30 feet of it. If the target can see the ultroloth, the target must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw against this magic or be charmed until the end of the ultroloth's next turn. The charmed target is stunned. If the target's saving throw is successful, the target is immune to the ultroloth's gaze for the next 24 hours.

actions.name: Teleport
actions.desc: The ultroloth magically teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

uraeus.name: Uraeus
uraeus.languages: understands Celestial and Common but can't speak

traits.name: Aerial Withdraw
traits.desc: The uraeus doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

traits.name: Ward Bond
traits.desc: As a bonus action, the uraeus forms a magical bond with a willing creature within 5 feet. Thereafter, regardless of the distance between them, the uraeus knows how far away and in which direction its ward is. It also knows its ward's general state of health. The bond persists until the uraeus or its ward perishes, or until the uraeus breaks the bond with an action.

traits.name: Bonded Savior
traits.desc: When the uraeus's ward takes damage, the serpent can transfer that damage to itself. Its damage resistances and immunities don't apply to transferred damage.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) poison damage. The target must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute. While poisoned this way, it takes 9 (2d8) poison damage at the start of each of its turns. A poisoned creature repeats the saving throw at the end of its turn, ending the effect on a success.

actions.name: Incandescent Breath (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: The uraeus breathes fire in a 15-foot cone. Creatures caught in the cone take 10 (3d6) fire damage, or half as much on a successful DC 12 Dexterity saving throw.

traits.name: Death Spasms
traits.desc: When a strangling watcher dies, it releases all the fear it consumed in life in a single wave of soul-rending terror. All creatures within 60 feet must succeed on a DC 19 Charisma saving throw. Those that fail are frightened. A frightened creature takes 13 (2d12) psychic damage at the start of each of its turns from the dread accumulated over centuries. It repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc:
The watcher's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 19). It can cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
At will: feather fall
3/day each: phantasmal killer, blur, merge with stone
1/day each: greater invisibility, evil eye, black tentacles

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.desc: The watcher can climb any surface, including walking on ceilings, without making an ability check.

traits.name: Squeeze
traits.desc: Despite their size, strangling watchers have thin, boneless bodies that let them slip through passages meant for Small creatures, without it affecting their movement or combat abilities.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The watcher makes four tentacle attacks.

actions.name: Tentacle
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (3d8 + 7) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 17). The target is restrained until the grapple ends. The watcher can grapple one target per tentacle.

actions.name: Paralyzing Gaze (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: The watcher can target one creature within 60 feet with its strange gaze. The target must succeed on a DC 19 Wisdom saving throw or be paralyzed for 1 minute. It repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. If a target succeeds on its saving throw or the effect ends for it, it is immune to the watcher's gaze for the next 24 hours.

legendaryActions.name: Crushing Attack
legendaryActions.desc: The urochar crushes a creature it grapples in a tentacle. The creature takes 25 (4d8 + 7) bludgeoning damage.

legendaryActions.name: Tentacle Attack
legendaryActions.desc: The watcher makes one tentacle attack.

legendaryActions.name: Springing Tentacle (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.desc: The urochar uses a tentacle to move up to 20 feet and reach an unoccupied space adjacent to a wall, ceiling, floor, or other solid surface. This movement doesn't trigger reactions. To use this action, the urochar must have at least one tentacle free (not grappling a creature). Grappled creatures move with the urochar.

traits.name: Dynastic Aura
traits.desc: A creature that starts its turn within 15 feet of an ushabti must make a DC 17 Constitution saving throw unless the ushabti is incapacitated. On a failure, the creature is left breathless and takes 9 (2d8) necrotic damage. It can't cast spells with verbal components or speak above a whisper until the end of the ushabti's next turn. On a success, it is immune to that ushabti's dynastic aura for the next 24 hours.

traits.name: Healing Theft
traits.desc: If a creature within 30 feet of the ushabti regains hit points thanks to a spell or magical effect, it receives only half the expected hit points while the ushabti regains the other half.

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.desc: The ushabti is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The ushabti has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.desc: The ushabti's weapon attacks are magical.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The ushabti makes one attack with its Medjai scepter and one with its khopesh.

actions.name: Medjai Scepter
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage plus 10 (3d6) poison damage.

actions.name: Khopesh
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.desc: The imy-ut ushabti regains 5 hit points at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 hit point.

traits.name: Torn Wrappings
traits.desc: A creature that touches an imy-ut ushabti or deals slashing or piercing damage to it while within 5 feet tears its delicate linen wrappings and releases a torrent of scarabs. The creature must succeed on a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw to avoid them. On a failure, they cover it and deal 3 (1d6) piercing damage at the start of each of its turns. A creature can remove the scarabs covering itself or an affected ally within reach by using an action and succeeding on a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw. The scarabs are destroyed if the affected creature takes area damage.

actions.name: Ceremonial Greatsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or take 5 (2d4) poison damage at the start of each of its turns. It repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

actions.name: Vomit Swarm (1/Day)
actions.desc:
The imy-ut ushabti willingly parts its wrappings and releases a swarm of scarabs that obey its mental commands. It has the same statistics as an insect swarm, but with the following attack instead of the insect swarm's normal Bites attack:
Bites. Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 0 ft., one creature. Hit: 10 (4d4) piercing damage, or 5 (2d4) piercing damage if the swarm has half of its hit points or fewer. The target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or take 5 (2d4) poison damage at the start of each of its turns. A poisoned target repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

vaettir.name: Vaettir
vaettir.languages: the languages it knew in life

traits.name: Greedy Bond
traits.desc: A corpse-black vaettir sees the face of any creature wearing or carrying an object that once belonged to it. It also knows the direction and distance of objects that once belonged to it, as long as someone else possesses them. If the object changes hands, its new holder becomes the vaettir's target. A bone-white vaettir sees the individuals who offended it. Time and distance have no effect on these abilities as long as the parties remain on the same plane.

traits.name: Rejected by Death
traits.desc: The vaettir is destroyed if it drops to 0 hit points, but it returns to unlife where it was slain at the following dusk, with all its hit points. To kill it for good, one must behead it, burn the corpse, and throw the ashes into the sea — or return it to its burial mound, place a pair of scissors on its chest, and drive needles into its feet.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc:
The vaettir's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 12). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
2/day each: gaseous form, hunter's mark
1/day each: enlarge/reduce, phantom steed
1/week each: compulsion, bestow curse, remove curse

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.desc: A vaettir avoids direct sunlight, as it has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks while exposed to it.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The vaettir makes two attacks with its greataxe or two attacks with its longbow.

actions.name: Greataxe
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (1d12 + 5) slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Longbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Cadaverous Breath (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: The vaettir spews a 15-foot cone of putrid gas. Creatures caught in the area must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1d4 rounds.

actions.name: Maddening Gaze (1/Day)
actions.desc: The vaettir can lock its gaze on a creature to drive it mad. Each creature within 30 feet of the vaettir that it fixes with its gaze must succeed on a DC 12 Charisma saving throw or become confused (as with the confusion spell) for 1d4 rounds. On a success, the creature is immune to this effect for the next 24 hours.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The aeonic wanderer can either use Backwards Drift or make two attacks with its time-warp staff. The wanderer's future version (if it has been summoned) can only use Forwards Drift.

actions.name: Time-Warp Staff
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d10 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Backwards Drift (1/Day)
actions.desc: A future version of an aeonic wanderer materializes in an unoccupied space within 30 feet of its present self. The future wanderer has the same statistics as its present version, all of its hit points, and its turn immediately follows its present self's. If the original aeonic wanderer dies, its future double disappears. If the present wanderer sees its future version die, it must make a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw. On a success, nothing happens. On a failure, roll a d6 to determine the effect it suffers: 1 = frightened, 2 = incapacitated, 3 = paralyzed, 4 = unconscious, 5 or 6 = disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks. This effect lasts 1d4 rounds.

actions.name: Forwards Drift (2/Day)
actions.desc: The future version makes one time-warp staff attack against a target. If the attack hits, instead of dealing bludgeoning damage, both the target and the attacker leap forward in time and effectively cease to exist in the present. They reappear in the same spot 1d4 rounds later, at the end of the present wanderer's turn. If creatures occupy those spaces at that moment, they are pushed 5 feet in a direction of their choice. The drift's target (but not the future wanderer) must then make a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw, with the same effect as an aeonic wanderer witnessing the death of its future version (see Backwards Drift). If it uses this power a second time, the drift's target reappears, but not the future wanderer. This doesn't trigger a saving throw for its present version.

valkyrie.name: Valkyrie
valkyrie.languages: Common, Giant, Dwarvish, plus any language (see Gift of Tongues)

traits.name: Weapons of Asgard
traits.desc: The valkyrie's weapon attacks are magical. When she hits with a weapon, she deals an extra 11 (2d10) radiant damage (included in the attacks below).

traits.name: Dreadful Presence
traits.desc: Each living creature that starts its turn within 60 feet of a valkyrie perceives her ominous aura and must succeed on a DC 16 Charisma saving throw or be frightened for 1d4 rounds. On a success, the creature is immune to this effect for 24 hours. The valkyrie can suppress this aura at will.

traits.name: Gift of Tongues
traits.desc: A valkyrie speaks fluently any language she hears spoken for at least a minute, and she retains that knowledge for her entire life.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc:
The valkyrie's innate spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 16, +8 to hit with spell attacks). She can cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
At will: bless, speak with animals, spare the dying, sacred flame, bane, invisibility, thaumaturgy
5/day each: warding bond, healing word, gentle repose
3/day each: beacon of hope, mass healing word, vigor
1/day each: compulsion, commune, freedom of movement, death ward

actions.name: Longsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage, or 9 (1d10 + 4) slashing damage if used with two hands, plus 11 (2d10) radiant damage.

actions.name: Spear
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage, or 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack, plus 11 (2d10) radiant damage.

legendaryActions.name: Cast a Cantrip
legendaryActions.desc: The valkyrie casts a spell from her list of at-will spells.

legendaryActions.name: Spear or Longsword Attack
legendaryActions.desc: The valkyrie makes one attack with her longsword or her spear.

legendaryActions.name: Harvest the Dead (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.desc: A valkyrie can take the soul of a recent dead and bind it to a weapon or shield. She can bind no more than one soul to a single object. An individual whose soul is bound can't be returned to life except by means of a wish or similar magic. A valkyrie can release a soul bound by another valkyrie or transfer a bound soul from one object to another. Once bound, the soul gives the object a +1 bonus per 4 character levels the soul possessed (maximum +3). This replaces any other magic previously active on the object. If the GM wishes, part of this bonus can become an appropriate special ability instead (for example, the soul of a fire giant can create a flaming weapon).

vampire.name: Vampire
languages: the languages it knew in life

traits.name: Shapechanger
traits.desc:
If the vampire isn't in sunlight or running water, it can use its action to polymorph into a Tiny bat or a Medium cloud of mist, or back into its true form.

While in bat form, the vampire can't speak, its walking speed is 5 feet, and it has a flying speed of 30 feet. Its statistics, other than its size and speed, are unchanged. Anything it is wearing transforms with it, but nothing it is carrying does. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

While in mist form, the vampire can't take any actions, speak, or manipulate objects. It is weightless, has a flying speed of 20 feet, can hover, and can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. In addition, if air can pass through a space, the mist can do so without squeezing, and it can't pass through water. It has advantage on Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution saving throws, and it is immune to all nonmagical damage, except the damage it takes from sunlight.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If the vampire fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Misty Escape
traits.desc:
When it drops to 0 hit points outside its resting place, the vampire transforms into a cloud of mist (as in the Shapechanger trait) instead of falling unconscious, provided that it isn't in sunlight or running water. If it can't transform, it is destroyed.

While it has 0 hit points in mist form, it can't revert to its vampire form, and it must reach its resting place within 2 hours or be destroyed. Once in its resting place, it reverts to its vampire form. It is then paralyzed until it regains at least 1 hit point. After spending 1 hour in its resting place with 0 hit points, it regains 1 hit point.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.desc: The vampire regains 20 hit points at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 hit point and isn't in sunlight or running water. If the vampire takes radiant damage or damage from Holy Water (Flask), this trait doesn't function at the start of the vampire's next turn.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.desc: The vampire can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Vampire Weaknesses
traits.desc:
The vampire has the following flaws:

- 
- 
- 
-

actions.name: Multiattack (Vampire Form Only)
actions.desc: The vampire makes two attacks, only one of which can be a bite attack.

actions.name: Unarmed Strike (Vampire Form Only)
actions.desc: mw 9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}8 (1d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage. Instead of dealing damage, the vampire can grapple the target (escape DC 18).

actions.name: Bite (Bat or Vampire Form Only)
actions.desc: mw 9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one willing creature, or a creature that is grappled by the vampire, incapacitated, or restrained. {@h}7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) necrotic damage. The target's hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the necrotic damage taken, and the vampire regains hit points equal to that amount. The reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its hit point maximum to 0. A humanoid slain in this way and then buried in the ground rises the following night as a vampire spawn under the vampire's control.

actions.name: Charm
actions.desc:
The vampire targets one humanoid it can see within 30 feet of it. If the target can see the vampire, the target must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw against this magic or be charmed by the vampire. The charmed target regards the vampire as a trusted friend to be heeded and protected. Although the target isn't under the vampire's control, it takes the vampire's requests or actions in the most favorable way it can, and it is a willing target for the vampire's bite attack.

Each time the vampire or the vampire's companions do anything harmful to the target, it can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success. Otherwise, the effect lasts 24 hours or until the vampire is destroyed, is on a different plane of existence than the target, or takes a bonus action to end the effect.

actions.name: Children of the Night (1/Day)
actions.desc: The vampire magically calls 2d4 swarms of swarm of bats or swarm of rats, provided that the sun isn't up. While outdoors, the vampire can call 3d6 wolf instead. The called creatures arrive in 1d4 rounds, acting as allies of the vampire and obeying its spoken commands. The beasts remain for 1 hour, until the vampire dies, or until the vampire dismisses them as a bonus action.

legendaryActions.name: Move
legendaryActions.desc: The vampire moves up to its speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

legendaryActions.name: Unarmed Strike
legendaryActions.desc: The vampire makes one unarmed strike.

legendaryActions.name: Bite (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.desc: The vampire makes one bite attack.

vampire-sorcier.name: Vampire
languages: the languages it knew in life

traits.name: Shapechanger
traits.desc:
If the vampire isn't in sunlight or running water, it can use its action to polymorph into a Tiny bat or a Medium cloud of mist, or back into its true form.

While in bat form, the vampire can't speak, its walking speed is 5 feet, and it has a flying speed of 30 feet. Its statistics, other than its size and speed, are unchanged. Anything it is wearing transforms with it, but nothing it is carrying does. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

While in mist form, the vampire can't take any actions, speak, or manipulate objects. It is weightless, has a flying speed of 20 feet, can hover, and can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. In addition, if air can pass through a space, the mist can do so without squeezing, and it can't pass through water. It has advantage on Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution saving throws, and it is immune to all nonmagical damage, except the damage it takes from sunlight.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If the vampire fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Misty Escape
traits.desc:
When it drops to 0 hit points outside its resting place, the vampire transforms into a cloud of mist (as in the Shapechanger trait) instead of falling unconscious, provided that it isn't in sunlight or running water. If it can't transform, it is destroyed.

While it has 0 hit points in mist form, it can't revert to its vampire form, and it must reach its resting place within 2 hours or be destroyed. Once in its resting place, it reverts to its vampire form. It is then paralyzed until it regains at least 1 hit point. After spending 1 hour in its resting place with 0 hit points, it regains 1 hit point.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.desc: The vampire regains 20 hit points at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 hit point and isn't in sunlight or running water. If the vampire takes radiant damage or damage from Holy Water (Flask), this trait doesn't function at the start of the vampire's next turn.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.desc: The vampire can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Vampire Weaknesses
traits.desc:
The vampire has the following flaws:

actions.name: Multiattack (Vampire Form Only)
actions.desc: The vampire makes two attacks, only one of which can be a bite attack.

actions.name: Unarmed Strike (Vampire Form Only)
actions.desc: mw 9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}8 (1d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage. Instead of dealing damage, the vampire can grapple the target (escape DC 18).

actions.name: Bite (Bat or Vampire Form Only)
actions.desc: mw 9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one willing creature, or a creature that is grappled by the vampire, incapacitated, or restrained. {@h}7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) necrotic damage. The target's hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the necrotic damage taken, and the vampire regains hit points equal to that amount. The reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its hit point maximum to 0. A humanoid slain in this way and then buried in the ground rises the following night as a vampire spawn under the vampire's control.

actions.name: Charm
actions.desc:
The vampire targets one humanoid it can see within 30 feet of it. If the target can see the vampire, the target must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw against this magic or be charmed by the vampire. The charmed target regards the vampire as a trusted friend to be heeded and protected. Although the target isn't under the vampire's control, it takes the vampire's requests or actions in the most favorable way it can, and it is a willing target for the vampire's bite attack.

Each time the vampire or the vampire's companions do anything harmful to the target, it can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success. Otherwise, the effect lasts 24 hours or until the vampire is destroyed, is on a different plane of existence than the target, or takes a bonus action to end the effect.

actions.name: Children of the Night (1/Day)
actions.desc: The vampire magically calls 2d4 swarms of swarm of bats or swarm of rats, provided that the sun isn't up. While outdoors, the vampire can call 3d6 wolf instead. The called creatures arrive in 1d4 rounds, acting as allies of the vampire and obeying its spoken commands. The beasts remain for 1 hour, until the vampire dies, or until the vampire dismisses them as a bonus action.

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.desc: The umbral vampire can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc:
The umbral vampire's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 15). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
At will: plane shift (Shadowfell only), mirror image
1/day each: bane (dim light or darkness only), black tentacles

traits.name: Shadow Meld
traits.desc: When the umbral vampire is in dim light or darkness, it can Hide as a bonus action, even while being observed.

traits.name: Strike from the Shadows
traits.desc: The vampire's umbral grip attack gains 10 feet of reach and deals an extra 4d6 damage when the vampire is hidden from its target and both are in dim light or darkness.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.desc: The umbral vampire has disadvantage on attack rolls and on Wisdom (Perception) checks based on sight while in direct sunlight.

actions.name: Umbral Grip
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (4d6 + 4) cold damage, and the target's Strength score is reduced by 1d6. The target dies if this reduces its Strength to 0; otherwise, the reduction persists until it finishes a long or short rest. If a non-evil humanoid dies from this attack, a shadow rises from its corpse 1d4 hours later.

languages: the languages it knew in life

traits.name: Corrupting Touch
traits.desc: When a corrupting ooze scores a critical hit or starts its turn with an adversary grappled, it can dissolve one leather, wood, or metal object of its choice in that adversary's possession. An ordinary object is automatically destroyed; a magic item is destroyed if its bearer fails a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw.

traits.name: Powerful Swimmer
traits.desc: A corrupting ooze floats naturally on water. It swims by pulsations that propel it faster than it walks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 3 (1d6) acid damage. The target is grappled (escape DC 13).

traits.name: Amorphous
traits.desc: The ooze can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

traits.name: Corrode Metal
traits.desc:
Any nonmagical weapon made of metal that hits the ooze corrodes. After dealing damage, the weapon takes a permanent and cumulative −1 penalty to damage rolls. If its penalty drops to −5, the weapon is destroyed. Nonmagical ammunition made of metal that hits the ooze is destroyed after dealing damage.

The ooze can eat through 2-inch-thick, nonmagical metal in 1 round.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.desc: While the ooze remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an oily pool or wet rock.

actions.name: Pseudopod
actions.desc: mw 3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 (1d6 + 1) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) acid damage, and if the target is wearing nonmagical metal armor, its armor is partly corroded and takes a permanent and cumulative −1 penalty to the AC it offers. The armor is destroyed if the penalty reduces its AC to 10.

traits.name: Keen Sight and Smell
traits.desc: The vulture has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight or smell.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.desc: The vulture has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the vulture's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

actions.name: Beak
actions.desc: mw 2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}2 (1d4) piercing damage.

traits.name: Keen Sight and Smell
traits.desc: The vulture has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight or smell.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.desc: The vulture has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the vulture's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The vulture makes two attacks: one with its beak and one with its talons.

actions.name: Beak
actions.desc: mw 4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 (2d4 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Talons
actions.desc: mw 4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 (2d6 + 2) slashing damage.

traits.name: Plant Camouflage
traits.desc: The vegepygmy has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks it makes in any terrain with ample obscuring vegetation.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.desc: The vegepygmy regains 3 hit points at the start of its turn. If it takes cold, fire, or necrotic damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the vegepygmy's next turn. The vegepygmy dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: mw 4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 (1d6 + 2) slashing damage.

actions.name: Sling
actions.desc: rw 4 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. {@h}4 (1d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.desc: The velociraptor has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the velociraptor's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The velociraptor makes one Bite attack and one Claw attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: mw 4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: mw 4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 (1d4 + 2) slashing damage.

traits.name: Air Form
traits.desc: The putrefying wind can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. It can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

traits.name: Polluting Presence
traits.desc: All liquids and plant life in the same space as the putrefying wind at the end of its turn are blighted and cursed. Normal vegetation dies in 1d4 days, while plant creatures take double damage from the wind's actions. Unattended liquids become toxic and unfit to drink.

traits.name: Invisibility
traits.desc: The putrefying wind is invisible, as with the greater invisibility spell.

actions.name: Decomposing Wind
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 0 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage plus 14 (4d6) necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be afflicted by the curse called tomb rot. An affected creature can no longer regain hit points, and its hit point maximum decreases by 10 (3d6) for every 24 hours that pass. If the curse reduces the target's hit point maximum to 0, it dies and its body crumbles to dust. The curse persists until someone removes it with remove curse or similar magic.

traits.name: Chromatic Form
traits.desc: When created, the animated breath takes one of five forms, matching its creator's breath weapon: Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Poison. This form determines the creature's AC, damage resistance, traits, and attacks.

traits.name: Fire Aura (Fire Form Only)
traits.desc: At the start of each of the animated breath's turns, each creature within 5 feet of it takes 3 (1d6) fire damage, and flammable objects in the aura that aren't being worn or carried ignite. A creature that touches the animated breath or hits it with a melee attack takes 3 (1d6) fire damage.

traits.name: Putrid Aura (Acid and Poison Forms Only)
traits.desc: A creature that starts its turn within 5 feet of the animated breath must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the start of its next turn. A creature that touches the animated breath or hits it with a melee attack takes 3 (1d6) acid damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The animated breath makes two Slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: mw 7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 11 (2d10) damage of a type determined by the animated breath's form: acid, cold, fire, lightning, or poison.

ver-givre-larve.name: Frost Worm Larva
ver-givre-larve.speed: 30 ft., swim 30 ft., burrow 20 ft. (snow and ice only)

traits.name: Frostborn
traits.desc: A frost worm larva breathes water as easily as air.

traits.name: Ravenous
traits.desc: In its larval stage, the frost worm is tormented by hunger. It can make opportunity attacks against enemies that disengage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The larva makes one tentacle attack and one gnawing attack.

actions.name: Tentacle
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Gnawing
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) slashing damage.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.desc: The worm can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings and along the threads with which it builds its traps, without needing an ability check. An angler worm can't be restrained by its own traps or by those of another angler worm.

traits.name: Sensitive Touch
traits.desc: The angler worm has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks based on vibrations.

traits.name: Transparent Trap
traits.desc: Spotting the threads forming an angler worm's trap requires a successful DC 12 Wisdom (Perception) check. This check always has disadvantage unless the creature making it can see invisible things. A creature that enters a space containing an angler worm trap must succeed on a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw or be restrained by the sticky threads (escape DC 14). This saving throw has disadvantage if the creature is unaware of the traps' presence.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: An angler worm makes one bite attack. It can also make one coils attack against each enemy restrained in its threads and within reach of its coils. Once it has coiled around a creature, it can no longer make coils attacks against the others.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) acid damage.

actions.name: Coils
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. Hit: 13 (3d8) acid damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw or be pulled into a space adjacent to the angler worm (if it isn't already) and grappled in its coils (escape DC 12). While grappled this way, the creature is considered restrained by the angler worm (but not by its trap threads), can't breathe, and takes 22 (5d8) acid damage at the start of each of the angler worm's turns. A creature that successfully escapes the worm's coils might have to immediately make another DC 12 Dexterity saving throw to avoid being restrained again, if it escapes into a space containing another trap.

actions.name: Ethereal Lure (Recharge 4-6)
actions.desc: The angler worm chooses a point within 20 feet of it. Faint blue light shines from that point until the start of its next turn. All creatures that can see the light at the start of their turn must succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed until the start of their next turn. A creature charmed this way must Dash toward the light by the most direct route possible, automatically fails all saving throws to avoid being restrained by the traps, and is unable to see the angler worm.

traits.name: Tunneler
traits.desc: The worm can burrow through solid rock at half its burrow speed and leaves a 10-foot-diameter tunnel in its wake.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The worm makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its stinger.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc:
mw 14 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}22 (3d8 + 9) piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it must succeed on a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw or be swallowed by the worm. A swallowed creature is blinded and restrained, it has Cover against attacks and other effects outside the worm, and it takes 21 (6d6) acid damage at the start of each of the worm's turns.

If the worm takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the worm must succeed on a DC 21 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which fall prone in a space within 10 feet of the worm. If the worm dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse by using 20 feet of movement, exiting prone.

actions.name: Tail Stinger
actions.desc: mw 14 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. {@h}19 (3d6 + 9) piercing damage, and the target must make a DC 19 Constitution saving throw, taking 42 (12d6) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

ver-sathaq.name: Sathaq Worm
ver-sathaq.languages: understands Deep Speech and Terran but can't speak

traits.name: Aura of Suffering
traits.desc: The sathaq worm's presence causes great pain to creatures native to the Material Plane. Any creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of the sathaq worm must make a DC 17 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, it is poisoned until the start of its next turn. On a success, it is immune to that worm's aura of suffering for the next 24 hours.

traits.name: Earth Glide
traits.desc: The sathaq worm can burrow through nonmagical, unworked earth and stone without disturbing the material it moves through.

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.desc: The sathaq worm deals double damage to objects and structures.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 24 (4d8 + 6) piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it must succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw or be swallowed by the sathaq worm. Once swallowed, it is blinded and restrained, has total cover against attacks and effects coming from outside the worm, and takes 7 (2d6) bludgeoning plus 7 (2d6) slashing plus 7 (2d6) acid damage at the start of each of the worm's turns. The sathaq worm can have only one swallowed creature at a time. If the worm takes 20 or more damage in a single turn from a creature inside it, it must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate the swallowed creature, which falls prone in a space within 5 feet of it. If the sathaq worm dies, the swallowed creature is no longer restrained and can exit the body by expending 10 feet of movement, exiting prone.

traits.name: Amorphous
traits.desc: The pudding can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

traits.name: Corrosive Form
traits.desc: A creature that touches the pudding or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 4 (1d8) acid damage. Any nonmagical weapon made of metal or wood that hits the pudding corrodes. After dealing damage, the weapon takes a permanent and cumulative −1 penalty to damage rolls. If its penalty drops to −5, the weapon is destroyed. Nonmagical ammunition made of metal or wood that hits the pudding is destroyed after dealing damage. The pudding can eat through 2-inch-thick, nonmagical wood or metal in 1 round.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.desc: The pudding can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: Pseudopod
actions.desc: mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 18 (4d8) acid damage. In addition, nonmagical armor worn by the target is partly dissolved and takes a permanent and cumulative −1 penalty to the AC it offers. The armor is destroyed if the penalty reduces its AC to 10.

reactions.name: Split
reactions.desc: When a pudding that is Medium or larger is subjected to lightning or slashing damage, it splits into two new puddings if it has at least 10 hit points. Each new pudding has hit points equal to half the original pudding's, rounded down. New puddings are one size smaller than the original pudding.

traits.name: Faux Appearance
traits.desc: While the vesiculose remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary pool of water.

traits.name: Rootlet Swarms
traits.desc: The vesiculose is constantly surrounded by four Medium swarms of Tiny rootlets that move as the plant directs them. Each has a speed of 30 feet, can be targeted independently, has 25 hit points, and (unlike the mother plant) is vulnerable to fire damage. Otherwise, it has the same statistics as the plant's main body. The vesiculose loses one of its Snare attacks each time a swarm drops to 0 hit points. A destroyed swarm regrows in 24 hours.

traits.name: Perfumed Water
traits.desc: The vesiculose's pool gives off a sweet fragrance that lures creatures and compels them to drink. Creatures (other than undead and constructs) within 60 feet must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or be compelled to approach the vesiculose and drink its water. The water is cool and refreshing but contains a soporific poison: any creature (other than undead and constructs) that drinks it regains 1d4 hit points and sheds a level of exhaustion, but it must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw against poison or fall unconscious for 1 minute. If the creature fails its saving throw by 5 or more, it is unconscious for 1 hour. An unconscious creature wakes if it takes damage or if another creature uses an action to shake it.

traits.name: Luxuriance
traits.desc: The vesiculose's sap seeps into the ground and fertilizes the vegetation. There are always 3d6 beneficial fruits (such as berries, nuts, figs, dates, and so on) within 30 feet of a vesiculose. They have the same effects as the goodberries of the eponymous spell, but they retain their properties for 1 week after being picked or after the vesiculose dies.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The vesiculose uses Snare four times and Coil and Envelope once each. It loses one Snare attack per rootlet swarm destroyed.

actions.name: Snare
actions.desc: The vesiculose targets a Large or smaller creature within 5 feet of one of its rootlet swarms. The target takes 10 (4d4) piercing damage and is grappled (escape DC 15). If it succeeds on a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw, it takes only half damage and isn't grappled. Until the grapple ends, it is restrained, has disadvantage on Strength saving throws and Strength checks, and the rootlet swarm responsible for the grapple can't grapple another target.

actions.name: Coil
actions.desc: Each rootlet swarm that has grappled a creature moves up to 20 feet toward the vesiculose's body. The rootlets can venture up to 100 feet from the body.

actions.name: Envelope
actions.desc: The vesiculose envelopes all restrained or unconscious creatures within 5 feet of its main body (up to 2 Large creatures, 4 Medium creatures, or 8 Small creatures). Once swallowed, a creature is restrained, has total cover against attacks and effects coming from outside the vesiculose, and takes 21 (6d6) acid damage at the start of each of the vesiculose's turns. When the vesiculose moves, enveloped creatures move with it. An enveloped creature can try to escape by using an action to make a DC 15 Strength check. On a success, it escapes and enters a space of its choice within 5 feet of the vesiculose's body.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The veteran makes two longsword attacks. If it has a shortsword drawn, it can also make a shortsword attack.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.desc: mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage, or 8 (1d10 + 3) slashing damage if used with two hands.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.desc: mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Heavy Crossbow
actions.desc: rw 3 to hit, range 100/400 ft., one target. {@h}6 (1d10 + 1) piercing damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The veteran makes two longsword attacks. If it has a shortsword drawn, it can also make a shortsword attack.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.desc: mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage, or 8 (1d10 + 3) slashing damage if used with two hands.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.desc: mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Heavy Crossbow
actions.desc: rw 3 to hit, range 100/400 ft., one target. {@h}6 (1d10 + 1) piercing damage.

actions.name: Fire Breath {@recharge 5}
actions.desc: The veteran exhales fire in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 24 (7d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

traits.name: Fed by Darkness
traits.desc: If a vidien is in magical darkness at the start of its turn, it heals 5 hit points.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The vidien has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects, except those that deal radiant damage.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc:
The vidien's innate spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 15, +7 with spell attacks). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
At will: detect magic, fear, darkness
3/day each: eldritch blast (3 beams), black tentacles
1/day each: phantasmal force, reverse gravity

traits.name: Natural Invisibility
traits.desc: A vidien in absolute darkness is considered invisible to creatures relying on normal vision or darkvision.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The vidien makes four tentacle attacks.

actions.name: Filament
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d8 + 6) slashing damage plus 11 (2d10) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Necrotic Burst (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: The vidien causes a burst of necrotic energy in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on itself. Creatures caught in the sphere take 35 (10d6) necrotic damage, or half as much on a successful DC 17 Constitution saving throw.

traits.name: Close Shaver
traits.desc: The wicked barber has advantage on attack rolls against creatures in the same space as it.

traits.name: Inhuman Quickness
traits.desc: The wicked barber can take two bonus actions on its turn instead of one. They must be different; it can't take the same bonus action twice in the same turn.

traits.name: Invasive
traits.desc: The wicked barber can enter a hostile creature's space (whatever its size), move through it, or even stay there without penalty.

traits.name: Nimble Escape
traits.desc: The wicked barber can take the Disengage or Hide action as a bonus action on each of its turns.

traits.name: Filch
traits.desc: The wicked barber can take the Use an Object action or make a Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) check as a bonus action.

traits.name: Shadow Step
traits.desc: As a bonus action, the wicked barber can magically teleport from a space of dim light or darkness it currently occupies to another space of dim light or darkness it can see within 80 feet. Equipment it wears or carries moves with it. The barber has advantage on the first melee attack it makes before the end of the turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The wicked barber makes two attacks with its straight razor.

actions.name: Straight Razor
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Festering Cut

The attack's victim and its allies who see the attack must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened for 1d4 rounds.

traits.name: Dance of the Unlucky (1/Day)
traits.desc: A vila who dances for 1 hour creates a fairy ring of small gray mushrooms. It persists for seven days and is 50 feet in diameter per vila participating in the dance. Creatures other than vilas that fall asleep (including magically) inside this ring have disadvantage on ability checks for 24 hours from the moment they wake.

traits.name: Forest Swiftness

traits.name: Forest Meld
traits.desc: A vila can meld into any tree of its forest for as long as it wishes, as with the merge with stone spell.

The vila's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 14). She can cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
3/day: sleep
1/week: control weather

actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d6 + 6) piercing damage.

actions.name: Short Bow +1
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d6 + 6) piercing damage.

actions.name: Fascinate (1/Day)
actions.desc: When the vila sings, creatures that can hear her within 60 feet must succeed on a DC 14 Charisma saving throw or be stunned for 1d4 rounds. Those that succeed on their save are immune to that vila's song for 24 hours.

actions.name: Song of the Forest (1/Day)
actions.desc: The vila can magically call 2d6 wolves or 2 wampus cats. The called creatures arrive in 1d4 rounds. They act as allies of the vila and obey her spoken commands. They remain for an hour, until the vila dies, or until she dismisses them as a bonus action.

While poisoned, the target is blinded and takes 7 (2d6) poison damage at the start of each of its turns. The target repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

traits.name: Swamp Camouflage
traits.desc: The marsh viper has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks while in swampy terrain.

The target repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

traits.name: Refrigerant Acid
traits.desc: The acid mist given off by a frost veil can reduce flesh and organic matter to nutrients it can absorb. Creatures that strike a frost veil with a melee weapon that lacks reach, or with an unarmed strike, take 4 (1d8) acid damage.

traits.name: Faux Appearance
traits.desc: While a frost veil is motionless, it is indistinguishable from a natural formation of frost or ice.

traits.name: Windborne
traits.desc: When carried by the wind, a frost veil can fly at a speed of 30 feet. In a strong wind, this speed is 60 feet.

actions.name: Multiattack

actions.name: Envelope
actions.desc: When a frost veil wraps around a Medium or smaller creature, that creature takes 14 (2d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage plus 13 (3d8) acid damage and is grappled (escape DC 15). The target also takes 9 (2d8) bludgeoning damage and 13 (3d8) acid damage at the end of each of its turns while grappled by the frost veil. A frost veil can't attack while it envelops a creature. All damage received by the frost veil is split evenly with the creature it envelops, except slashing and psychic damage, which affect only the frost veil.

actions.name: Spirit Spores (Recharge 6)
actions.desc: When in distress, frost veils release around themselves a 10-foot cube of psychotropic spores. Creatures caught in this cloud must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw against poison or suffer hallucinations, as if affected by the confusion spell, for 1d3 rounds.

actions.name: Stunning Screech (1/Day)
actions.desc: The vrock emits a horrific screech. Each creature within 20 feet of it that can hear it and that isn't a demon must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be stunned until the end of the vrock's next turn.

Each creature must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or be restrained. A restrained creature can spend an action to make a DC 15 Strength check to free itself or another restrained creature, ending the effect on a success. A creature restrained by this trait moves with the sand wyrm. The wyrm's stinger attack has advantage against creatures restrained by this trait.

If the poison damage reduces the target to 0 hit points, the target is stable but poisoned and paralyzed for 1 hour. Regaining hit points doesn't end the poison or the paralysis.

traits.desc: When she casts a spell that has a casting time of 1 action, Xandala changes the casting time to 1 bonus action for that casting.

xanka.name: Xanka
xanka.languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.desc: The xanka's weapon attacks are magical.

traits.name: Weapon Ingestion
traits.desc: When the xanka is hit by a melee weapon and the final adjusted attack roll is 19 or lower, that weapon suffers a permanent -1 penalty to damage rolls after dealing this attack's damage. If the penalty reaches -5, the weapon is destroyed. Even magic weapons are subject to this effect.

actions.name: Absorb
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) force damage, and the xanka regains hit points equal to the damage dealt by this attack. In addition, if this attack hits a living creature, that creature must succeed on a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw or have a gaping wound open on it, dealing 2 (1d4) necrotic damage at the end of each of its turns until it is healed by magic or with a successful DC 10 Intelligence (Medicine) check. If the creature that fails this saving throw wears armor or a shield, it can avoid the necrotic damage by instead permanently reducing its armor or shield's AC by 1.

traits.name: Grasp a Thread of Fate
traits.desc: The xhkarsh targets a creature whose fate it has already corrupted within 5 feet. The target must succeed on a DC 15 Charisma saving throw or a portion of the xhkarsh's consciousness installs itself in its body. The target still controls itself, but the xhkarsh can control its actions for 1 minute per day and alter its memories as a bonus action (as if casting the modify memory spell, DC 15). The target is unaware of the xhkarsh's presence but can make a DC 18 Wisdom (Insight) check once per 24 hours to notice it. The effect persists until the xhkarsh ends it or the target's fate is restored with dispel evil and good or similar magic. The victim is immune to this effect for 24 hours when it succeeds on a saving throw against it and after the effect ends for any reason. A xhkarsh can hold up to four threads of fate at a time.

traits.name: Invisibility
traits.desc: The xhkarsh is invisible until it attacks or casts a spell, or until its concentration breaks. Equipment the xhkarsh wears and carries becomes as invisible as it is.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The xhkarsh makes two claw attacks and two stinger attacks.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage.

actions.name: Stinger
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) piercing damage. The target must succeed on a DC 15 Charisma saving throw or have its fate corrupted. A corrupted target has disadvantage on Charisma checks and saving throws and is immune to divination spells and effects that sense emotions or read thoughts. The target's fate can be restored with a dispel evil and good spell or similar magic.

traits.name: Earth Glide
traits.desc: The xorn can burrow through nonmagical, unworked earth and stone. While doing so, the xorn doesn't disturb the material it moves through.

traits.name: Stone Camouflage
traits.desc: The xorn has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide in rocky terrain.

traits.name: Treasure Sense
traits.desc: The xorn can pinpoint, by scent, the location of precious metals and stones, such as coins and gems, within 60 feet of it.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The xorn makes three claw attacks and one bite attack.

traits.name: Sharp Horns

traits.name: Peaceful Creature
traits.desc: The ychen bannog hates fighting and prefers to flee from combat. If it can't, it attacks an enemy or obstacle to carve a path to safety. A rider mounted on a ychen bannog, or a handler on foot beside it, can use an action to make a DC 16 Wisdom (Animal Handling) check. On a success, the ychen bannog moves and attacks as directed. On a failure, the beast flees. The handler or rider must be proficient in Animal Handling to attempt the check.

traits.name: Trample
traits.desc: When the ychen bannog takes the Dash action, it can move through the space of a Large or smaller creature, treating that space as difficult terrain. It can make a tread attack as a bonus action as it moves through the creature's space.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The ychen bannog makes one gore attack and one tread attack.

actions.name: Gore
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 27 (4d8 + 9) piercing damage.

actions.name: Devastating Bellow (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: The ychen bannog lets out a terrifying bellow audible up to 10 miles away. Structures and unattended objects in an 60-foot cone take 55 (10d10) thunder damage. Creatures in the cone take 27 (5d10) thunder damage and are deafened for 1 hour. They take only half damage and aren't deafened on a successful DC 18 Constitution saving throw.

traits.name: Fear of Fire
traits.desc: If the yeti takes fire damage, it has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks until the end of its next turn.

traits.name: Keen Smell

If the target can see the yeti, the target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw against this magic or take 10 (3d6) cold damage and then be paralyzed for 1 minute, unless it is immune to cold damage. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If the target's saving throw is successful, or if the effect ends on it, the target is immune to the Chilling Gaze of all yetis (but not abominable yetis) for 1 hour.

The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If the target's saving throw is successful, or if the effect ends on it, the target is immune to this yeti's gaze for 1 hour.

actions.desc: The yeti exhales a 30-foot cone of frigid air. Each creature in that area must make a DC 18 Constitution saving throw, taking 45 (10d8) cold damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

traits.name: Shapechanger
traits.desc: The yochlol can use its action to polymorph into a form that resembles a female drow or giant spider, or back into its true form. Its statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The yochlol has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.desc: The yochlol can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Web Walker
traits.desc: The yochlol ignores movement restrictions caused by webbing.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The yochlol makes two melee attacks.

actions.name: Slam (Bite in Spider Form)
actions.desc: mw 6 to hit, reach 5 ft. (10 feet in demon form), one target. {@h}5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning (piercing in spider form) damage plus 21 (6d6) poison damage.

actions.name: Mist Form
actions.desc:
The yochlol transforms into toxic mist or reverts to its true form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying is also transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

While in mist form, the yochlol is incapacitated and can't speak. It has a flying speed of 30 feet, can hover, and can pass through any space that isn't airtight. It has advantage on Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution saving throws, and it is immune to nonmagical damage.

While in mist form, the yochlol can enter a creature's space and stop there. Each time that creature starts its turn with the yochlol in its space, the creature must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the start of its next turn. While poisoned in this way, the target is incapacitated.

traits.name: Shapechanger

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If the zaratan fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.desc: The elemental deals double damage to objects and structures (included in Earth-Shaking Movement).

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The zaratan makes one Bite attack and one Stomp attack.

A creature takes 33 (6d10) bludgeoning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature that fails the save by 5 or more is knocked prone.

legendaryActions.name: Stomp
legendaryActions.desc: The zaratan makes one Stomp attack.

legendaryActions.name: Move
legendaryActions.desc: The zaratan moves up to its speed.

legendaryActions.name: Spit (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.desc: The zaratan makes one Spit Rock attack.

legendaryActions.name: Retract (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.desc: The zaratan retracts into its shell. Until it takes its Emerge action, it has resistance to all damage, and it is restrained. The next time it takes a legendary action, it must take its Revitalize or Emerge action.

legendaryActions.name: Revitalize (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.desc: The zaratan can use this option only if it is retracted in its shell. It regains 52 (5d20) hit points. The next time it takes a legendary action, it must take its Emerge action.

legendaryActions.name: Emerge (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.desc: The zaratan emerges from its shell and makes one Spit Rock attack. It can use this option only if it is retracted in its shell.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The zimwi makes one claw attack and one bite attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature grappled by the zimwi, it is swallowed and the grapple ends. Once swallowed, the creature is blinded and restrained, has total cover against attacks and effects coming from outside the zimwi, and takes 14 (4d6) acid damage at the start of each of the zimwi's turns. If the zimwi's stomach takes 20 or more damage in a single turn from a creature inside it, the zimwi must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which fall prone in spaces within 5 feet of it. Damage dealt to the zimwi's stomach doesn't harm the zimwi. Its stomach is bigger on the inside than on the outside; it can hold two Medium swallowed creatures or four Small or smaller swallowed creatures at a time. If the zimwi dies, swallowed creatures are no longer restrained and can escape by expending 5 feet of movement, exiting prone.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature and the zimwi isn't grappling anyone, it is grappled (escape DC 11).

traits.name: Dragon Wings
traits.desc: As a bonus action on his turn, Zindar can sprout a pair of dragon wings from his back, gaining a flying speed of 30 feet until he dismisses them as a bonus action.

actions.name: Quarterstaff
actions.desc: mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage, or 6 (1d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage when used with two hands.

actions.name: Breath Weapon {@recharge 5}
actions.desc: Zindar uses one of the following options:

actions.name: Fire Breath
actions.desc: Zindar exhales fire in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 22 (4d10) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

actions.name: Weakening Breath
actions.desc: Zindar exhales gas in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or have disadvantage on Strength-based attack rolls, Strength checks, and Strength saving throws for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.desc: The zmey can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Leap from Lake to Lake
traits.desc: A zmey spends most of its time in lakes and ponds. While submerged in a natural body of still water, it can move as a bonus action to a similar body of water within 5,000 feet. This power doesn't work in a fast current, but the zmey can leap from or into a river or stream with calm, lazy waters.

traits.name: Multiple Heads
traits.desc: The zmey typically has three heads. While it has more than one head, it has advantage on saving throws against being blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, and stunned. If the zmey takes 40 or more damage in a single turn (other than psychic or poison damage), one of its heads is severed. It dies if all three are cut off.

traits.name: Loathsome Limbs
traits.desc:
Whenever the zombie takes at least 5 bludgeoning or slashing damage at one time, roll a d20 to determine what else happens to it:

1–8: One leg is severed from the zombie if it has any legs left.

9–16: One arm is severed from the zombie if it has any arms left.

17–20: The zombie is decapitated.

If the zombie is reduced to 0 hit points, all parts of it die. Until then, a severed part acts on the zombie's initiative and has its own action and movement. A severed part has AC 8. Any damage it takes is subtracted from the zombie's hit points.

A severed leg is unable to attack and has a speed of 5 feet.

A severed arm has a speed of 5 feet and can make one claw attack on its turn, with disadvantage on the attack roll. Each time the zombie loses an arm, it loses a claw attack.

If its head is severed, the zombie loses its bite attack and its body is blinded unless the head can see it. The severed head has a speed of 0 feet. It can make a bite attack, but only against a target in its space.

The zombie's speed is halved if it's missing a leg. If it loses both legs, it falls prone. If it has both arms, it can crawl. With only one arm, it can still crawl, but its speed is halved. With no arms or legs, its speed is 0 feet, and it can't benefit from bonuses to speed.
